jobs.title: Director Wellness Marketing
jobs.description:
Overview

Discover greater levels of performance. With over 1,400 stores throughout the U.S. and an innovative omni-channel ecosystem, Ulta Beauty is revolutionizing the beauty retail experience. Ulta Beauty is expanding its digital capabilities, opening new stores on a continual basis and re-designing existing locations with the latest design and technological advancements for heightened guest experiences. We’re not just growing, we’re thriving through consistent innovation and a bold commitment to re-imagination. If you want the opportunity to build something strategic, to take ownership of your career trajectory, to apply your passion to operational excellence, Ulta Beauty provides the kind of stability and support few organizations can match. So be curious. Be flexible. Be more than you thought possible. The future is yours at Ulta Beauty.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Use your passion, experience and talents to build something BEAUTIFUL!

The Director, Wellness Marketing will be a key leader responsible for defining and bringing to life the end-to-end marketing strategy for Wellness at Ulta Beauty. This leader will establish how Wellness shows up for our guests across the full marketing ecosystem—building awareness, credibility and engagement while translating business priorities, guest insights and cultural trends into integrated marketing strategies that drive category growth.

Reporting to the Vice President, Wellness Commercial Lead, this role will serve as the primary marketing leader for the Wellness business and a critical bridge between the Wellness and Marketing organizations. The Director will work closely with Marketing leadership and functional teams across brand and integrated marketing, media, social, customer growth marketing, creative, consumer insights and other channels to ensure Wellness is thoughtfully and cohesively integrated throughout Ulta Beauty's marketing plans.

Importantly, this leader will help shape how Beauty and Wellness come together at Ulta Beauty, identifying opportunities to connect the categories through relevant guest experiences, storytelling, campaigns and activations. The Director will own the Wellness positioning and brand strategy, helping establish how Ulta Beauty earns credibility and builds a differentiated position in Wellness while remaining authentic to the broader Ulta Beauty brand.

The Director will lead a Wellness Marketing Manager, and will operate through significant cross-functional influence across both the Wellness organization and the broader enterprise. The ideal candidate is a strong brand strategist and storyteller who combines the art and science of marketing, thrives in an entrepreneurial environment and can translate an ambitious business strategy into compelling guest-facing experiences. This builds upon the existing Wellness Marketing role's mandate around omnichannel campaigns, Wellness brand identity and partnership across Wellness and Marketing, while elevating accountability to Director-level strategy, leadership and enterprise integration.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Own the end-to-end marketing strategy for Wellness by Ulta Beauty, translating the Wellness business strategy, growth priorities, guest insights and cultural trends into a differentiated, full-funnel marketing strategy across paid, owned and earned channels.
Define the annual and long-range Wellness marketing strategy, including audience priorities, positioning, messaging, campaign architecture, channel strategy and measurement approach, ensuring marketing plans support both category growth and Ulta Beauty brand objectives.
Own and evolve the Wellness brand strategy and positioning in alignment with the Ulta Beauty Brand, establishing how Ulta Beauty builds authority, relevance and credibility in Wellness and translating that strategy into clear and compelling guest-facing storytelling and experiences.
Serve as the primary connector between the Wellness and Marketing organizations, working closely with Marketing leadership and functional teams to integrate Wellness priorities across brand and integrated marketing, media, social, customer growth marketing, creative, consumer insights and other marketing capabilities.
Champion the integration of Beauty + Wellness across Ulta Beauty's marketing ecosystem, identifying opportunities to connect categories and guest needs through enterprise campaigns, seasonal moments, cultural moments, content and activations.
Lead the development of integrated, omnichannel Wellness campaigns and initiatives from strategy through execution, including strategic briefs, messaging, go-to-market plans, channel integration and measurement.
Partner with Marketing leaders and channel owners to determine the optimal marketing mix for Wellness, including paid and organic media, social, CRM/customer growth, digital, content, in-store and other guest touchpoints.
Serve as an indispensable partner to Wellness Merchandising and brand partners, developing marketing strategies and activations that support category priorities, accelerate established brands, successfully introduce emerging brands and create differentiated reasons for guests to shop Wellness at Ulta Beauty. This partnership model builds on the existing Wellness Marketing Manager mandate.
Partner with the Vice President, Wellness on development and stewardship of the overall Wellness marketing budget; own execution of marketing spend in partnership with Marketing functional leaders, ensuring investments are aligned to strategic priorities and deployed effectively.
Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks for Wellness marketing; analyze campaign and business performance, synthesize learnings and continuously optimize marketing strategies, investments and execution.
Maintain a strong pulse on Wellness, retail and consumer trends, cultural shifts, competitive dynamics and emerging marketing capabilities, translating insights into opportunities for Ulta Beauty. The source roles similarly emphasize industry trends, consumer behavior and competitive knowledge as inputs to strategy.
Lead, coach and develop the Wellness Marketing Manager, fostering strategic thinking, strong execution, collaboration and accountability while creating opportunities for professional growth.
Build strong relationships and influence across a highly matrixed organization, aligning diverse stakeholders around a clear Wellness marketing vision and translating ambiguity into actionable strategies and plans.
Develop and present compelling marketing strategies, recommendations and business updates to senior leadership, effectively communicating the role of marketing in driving Wellness growth.

REQUIREMENTS FOR CONSIDERATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or related field; MBA or MA preferred.
10+ years of progressive consumer marketing experience, with demonstrated success developing brand, category and/or integrated marketing strategies that drive measurable business results.
5+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to develop talent and build high-performing teams.
Proven expertise developing and leading 360° integrated marketing strategies and campaigns across the consumer funnel and multiple marketing channels, consistent with the expectations established for Ulta Beauty's Director-level category marketing leadership.
Strong brand strategist and storyteller with experience translating consumer insights, business objectives and cultural trends into differentiated positioning, messaging and marketing experiences.
Deep understanding of the modern marketing ecosystem, including brand and integrated marketing, paid media, social and content, CRM/customer growth marketing, digital and retail experiences.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a complex, matrixed organization and build trusted relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
Strategic thinker with a strong data-driven mindset and ability to move fluidly between long-range strategy and detailed execution.
Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building new capabilities, strategies and ways of working in a fast-paced, evolving business.
Strong financial acumen with experience managing marketing investments, agency resources and complex budgets.
Exceptional written, verbal and presentation skills, including experience developing and presenting high-impact recommendations to senior leadership.
High emotional intelligence with the ability to adapt communication and leadership style to diverse internal and external stakeholders.
Experience managing creative, media and/or other external agency partners.
Wellness industry/category experience preferred, with a strong understanding of the Wellness consumer, cultural landscape and evolving category dynamics considered a plus.
Passion for the business, curiosity and a commitment to being a lifelong learner.

The pay range for this position is $147,300.00 - $200,000.00 / Year with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn additional compensation pursuant to the Company’s bonus plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta

About

At Ulta Beauty
(NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful
. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest records, conviction records, or other criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of any applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
About Mueller Communications

Mueller Communications is a full-service communications, public relations and marketing firm based in Milwaukee. For more than 40 years, we've helped organizations, leaders and influencers tell their stories and amplify their impact through comprehensive marketing campaigns, media relations, public affairs, creative, and crisis communications. Today, our team of nearly 50 professionals serves clients across a diverse set of industries, and we're proud that many of our senior staff have called Mueller home for a decade or more.

With integrity at the heart of everything we do, our team of strategic communicators and problem solvers is committed to doing right by our clients, our community and each other.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Senior Manager-Performance Marketing is a collaborative problem solver who strategizes, builds, and optimizes campaigns to achieve measurable client goals. They set search-led demand generation strategy, direct junior campaign staff on execution, stay hands-on with our most complex accounts, and deliver and clearly communicate the results clients care about: qualified leads and pipeline.

The performance marketing function at Mueller Communications serves a diverse set of organizations including local, national, B2B, B2C, non-profit, for-profit, professional services, and eCommerce. Much of our work is lead generation for B2B and niche-industry clients, where a qualified lead is worth real money and attribution is the difference between a campaign that looks good and one that proves ROI.

Today, roughly two-thirds of Google searches end without a click. Winning there takes a ‘search everywhere’ approach: paid (SEM), organic (SEO), and AI visibility (AIO / GEO / AEO) managed as one program, fed by authoritative content, made credible by third-party coverage and endorsement. Mueller's elite talent works across every discipline that shapes search; we are seeking a performance marketer who can lead clients through this shift, seeing around the next corner before their competitors do.

What You'll Be Doing

Paid Media Campaign Management

Set strategy for and lead the builds of best-in-class paid search campaigns (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), plus paid social and programmatic where client goals warrant
Stay hands-on with our most complex accounts: campaign architecture, budget pacing, bidding strategy, audience and keyword development, and structured testing
Drive lead generation as the primary outcome, and eCommerce revenue where clients sell direct, optimizing to cost per qualified lead, pipeline contribution, and ROAS rather than platform metrics alone.

Demand Generation & Lead Gen Attribution

Build demand as well as capture it, shaping audience strategy, nurture sequencing, and the content programs that reach buyers before they start searching
Architect full-funnel attribution: connect ad platforms to CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce and similar) and, where needed, systems like ERPs, so lead scoring and qualification tie spend to opportunities and revenue
Provide actionable insights, direct optimization response, and set strategy using analytics platforms such as Google Analytics/Tag Manager/Search Console, SEMRush, CallRail, Google Data Studio, and Mueller’s internal suite of tracking and analysis tools.
Lead client-facing performance summary presentations that articulate key takeaways and showcase campaign impact in alignment with client goals

Search & AI Visibility

Work with our SEO team to guide organic strategy and direct its execution, ensuring paid and organic search work as one program rather than two silos
Continue to evolve the firm's approach to AI search visibility: how clients appear in AI Overviews and in answers generated by LLMs, and how we measure and grow that presence
Work with Mueller's proprietary, industry-leading AI search visibility and optimization platform, and help drive its continued evolution

Team & Project Management

Direct and develop junior campaign staff, delegating execution while owning strategy and quality
Own the firm's performance reporting, providing humanized communication of ROI in alignment with client goals
Optimize the firm's campaign planning and delivery process
Lead campaign activities in collaboration with the Client Lead (goal setting and reporting, projections, monthly planning, and regular internal client reviews)

Client Management

Be a strategic and analytical voice of the firm on our most complex campaigns
Collaborate with the Client Lead, or in some cases act as Client Lead, to ensure the Mueller team is a trusted partner, proactively providing clients with timely, useful, trusted information

Strategy Development | Entrepreneurial Mindset

Set and manage big-picture goals for clients and the firm and demonstrate passion for and ownership of achieving them
Contribute proactive ideas and suggestions for how to grow business from current clients
Pursue new business opportunities for the firm, including participation in pitch meetings and proposal development
Keep the firm at the forefront of the search industry by identifying technology, trends, and insights to be leveraged in both work delivery and business development

Qualifications That Will Make You Stand Out

7+ years in digital marketing with deep, hands-on paid search (SEM) expertise: you have owned strategy, budgets, and performance on complex accounts
Lead gen attribution you have built yourself: CRM-connected measurement (HubSpot, Salesforce or similar), lead scoring, full-funnel reporting, and comfort speaking in pipeline and revenue terms. Demand generation experience beyond capture is a plus.
A search everywhere mindset: working knowledge of SEO, a genuine point of view on AI search visibility (AIO/GEO), and an instinct for managing paid, organic, and AI presence as one program. Organic and AI search expertise will make you stand out, but we are willing to develop it in someone whose paid search and attribution credentials are proven.
Experience directing and developing junior staff, with a demonstrated desire to teach, mentor, and promote a positive team mentality
B2B or niche-industry experience preferred
Prior agency experience preferred, but not required
Proven ability to translate complex analyses into actionable recommendations that drive tangible results
Intrinsic sense of ownership of your domain and pride in your impact on the success of clients and the firm
Experience in client-facing roles with a strong track record of building long-tenured relationships that deliver on shared goals
This is a flexible hybrid role based in Milwaukee, WI

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

Total Rewards offering that includes a competitive salary, 401(k) and profit-sharing, bonuses, and comprehensive health and wellness benefits
Award-winning culture that earned us Milwaukee Business Journal's Best Place to Work 7 years running (2020 - 2026)
Beautiful newly-renovated modern workspace perfected for collaboration
Flexible hybrid working model that prioritizes work/life balance so you can live your best life at work and at home
Emphasis on professional development that includes paid membership in professional associations, internal lunches to support company growth and other career ambitions
One-of-a-kind concierge program dedicated to help the entire Mueller team discover an improved sense of workplace satisfaction, celebration, and organization
Regular Happy Hours and company outings to socialize with colleagues, have fun, and strengthen the team
Fully stocked kitchen so no one ever has to skip breakfast or lunch to meet their deadlines

Promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels with the goal of driving revenue and supporting total hotel goals. Builds direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to drive consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness. Showcases Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons. Connects into resources in their region. Liaises and builds deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization. Develops and executes basic marketing strategy across multiple outlets and for the positioning and pull-through of continent strategy that align with hotel goals. Supports and implements marketing strategies designed to drive topline revenue and achieve RevPar/share-of-wallet goals. Manages all internal and external communication, digital presence, including but not limited to property website, third party channels and social media while maintaining brand integrity. Activates incremental marketing opportunities ranging from partnerships, third-party sites and CVBs. Reports out on campaign performance to SMR (Sales, Marketing & Revenue Management) leadership as requested.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience Required:

2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in

the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred

OR

4-year bachelor's degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Marketing and Digital

Develops and executes the overarching marketing strategy from marketing plans to budgets for hotel/group of hotels that align with business priorities, with support and consultation of the General Manager(s).
Cultivates partnership with and active participation in demand generation strategy development (SMR).
Reconciles marketing plan monthly with accruals, forecast in conjunction with Director of Finance.
Leads and/or partners with Hotel Operations to conceptualize/execute property-level Programming and Activation, based on brand guidelines.
Serves as the hotel(s) brand guardian / liaison, verifying all marketing reflects brand voice. Leads the strategic pull-through of continent and brand promotions and campaigns.
Partners with Revenue Management to develop and execute promotional strategy.
Develops and manages property email marketing strategy, digital strategy across M.com and Third-Party sites, paid media campaigns and performance and verifies proper execution.
Supports group lead generation efforts.
Runs, reviews, analyzes and clearly articulates to stakeholders’ key reports and adjust strategy accordingly.
Manages internal and external partners to verify deliverables are executed to support hotel strategy.
Develops annual digital marketing plan to maximize hotel revenue production and identify digital marketing opportunities on third party and local partner sites.
Monitors and provides recommendations for SEO and update as needed in collaboration with MDS or agency.

Content Management

Sets overarching messaging strategy for hotel/group of hotels aligned with positioning.
Manages Marriott.com content (via EPIC, Efast, MDS Client Community, etc.), OTA content (via respective extranet sites) and Third-Party / Group Site content (via respective content management systems).
Manages photography distribution including search photos, pre-arrival photos, and photo gallery management.
Creates landing pages and Discovery Pages to enhance content, as applicable.
Manages guest communications (e.g. confirmation, pre-arrival, etc.).

Partnerships and Public Relations

Identifies and cultivates partnerships internally and externally, including Marriott Digital Services (MDS).
Maintains frequent, active engagement with Area Directors of Marketing to communicate overall recommendations and actionable next steps based on identified findings, best practices, and overall digital trends for their portfolio of hotels.
Manages PR agency, if applicable, or internal PR messaging.
Manages execution of PR events and promotions.

Outlet and Ancillary

Manages outlet marketing opportunities on third party and local partner sites.
Defines in-house F&B programming in partnership with F&B Director and manage execution.

Social Media

Develops and implements social strategy.
Manages paid social media budget and strategy.
Assists in reviewing social media content calendars and collect local area and property events.

General

Leads, owns and directs asset development, including hotel collateral, photoshoots (sourcing, planning, on-site execution, post-editing and

distribution), etc.

Measures and communicates success of campaigns and digital performance using relevant reports tools.
Demonstrates the ability to create and maintain strong relationships and negotiation skills with key internal and external partners/stakeholders (e.g. GMs, Sales and Revenue Leaders, Regional Team, media representatives).
Collects, reviews, and submits invoices for property marketing efforts and manage the overall submission process.
Completes other reasonable duties as requested by leadership.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.

Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be

to an amazing global team, and become
the best version of you.

jobs.description:
As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters is a global leader in life sciences, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.

We Are The People Who Give Possibilities Purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.

Job Description

About the role:

We are seeking a collaborative, results-oriented Growth Marketing
Campaign Manager
to join our US Regional Marketing team. This role will plan, execute, and optimize integrated marketing campaigns that build awareness, generate demand, and support commercial growth.

The Campaign Manager will coordinate campaigns across internal teams, agencies, and external partners, with responsibility for third-party media planning and trafficking and the day-to-day management of the US Google Ads account.

Key Responsibilities

Omnichannel Growth Marketing & Demand Generation

Develop integrated demand generation campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, qualified leads, pipeline growth, and revenue
Execute omnichannel growth marketing campaigns across web, email, SEO/SEM, paid media, social media, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing programs
Translate marketing priorities into actionable campaign plans with defined audiences, tactics, timelines, budgets, and KPIs.
Manage third-party media programs, including media coordination, asset delivery, tracking requirements, budgets, and performance.
Coordinate the accurate implementation of campaign tracking, UTM parameters, landing pages, and other digital campaign elements.
Manage multiple campaigns and deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail.
Develop and adapt campaign content for select marketing channels, including email, digital advertising, landing pages, and third-party media, in collaboration with product marketing, agencies, and other internal partners.

Paid Media Management

Coordinate with agency partners to monitor pacing, performance, and optimization opportunities of Search Engine Marketing campaigns
Review search terms, ad copy, keywords, audiences and performance to recommend improvements.
Coordinate with product managers to implement new campaigns
Support paid media reporting and communicate actionable insights to stakeholders.

Performance & Insights

Track and report performance against key business metrics
Monitor campaign performance and recommend adjustments to improve engagement, conversions, lead generation, and marketing efficiency.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field.
At least 5 years of experience in campaign management, digital marketing, demand generation, paid media, or a related discipline.
Hands-on experience executing multichannel marketing campaigns.
Experience with paid media, media agencies, publishers, or advertising vendors.
Working knowledge of Google Ads or another paid-search platform; hands-on Google Ads experience preferred.
Understanding of digital marketing metrics such as CTR, conversions, cost per conversion, and ROAS.
Strong project management, organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
Familiarity with Salesforce, Marketo, Google Analytics, or comparable CRM, marketing automation, and analytics platforms is preferred.
B2B, life sciences, biotechnology, healthcare, or other technical industry experience is preferred.

At BD, we prioritize on-site collaboration because we believe it fosters creativity, innovation, and effective problem-solving, which are essential in the fast-paced healthcare industry. For most roles, we require a minimum of 4 days of in-office presence per week to maintain our culture of excellence and ensure smooth operations, while also recognizing the importance of flexibility and work-life balance. Remote or field-based positions will have different workplace arrangements which will be indicated in the job posting.

For certain roles at BD, employment is contingent upon the Company’s receipt of sufficient proof that you are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. In some locations, testing for COVID-19 may be available and/or required. Consistent with BD’s Workplace Accommodations Policy, requests for accommodation will be considered pursuant to applicable law.

Why Join Us?

To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.

We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.

To learn more about BD visit
https://bd.com/careers.

We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, marital or domestic or civil union status, familial status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, disability, military eligibility or veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.  

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Rocket Travel by Agoda
Rocket Travel by Agoda is a travel technology company founded in 2012 under our flagship consumer facing product, rocketmiles.com. Since then, we have evolved to partner with some of the largest consumer travel brands in the world creating white-label solutions that allow customers to earn and redeem miles and points for booking hotels, rental cars, flights and activities. Our global partnerships range from world-class airlines to international banks to large-scale shopping platforms.  We help our partners develop successful go-to-market strategies through marketing expertise and data to support their overall growth. 
We attract customers from every corner of the globe with a seamless user experience that's built in-house from ideation to finished product: our team includes front- and back-end developers, customer service, data analysts, designers, marketers, accountants, partnership sales, and managers. 
Rocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career, and expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues. We encourage all applicants with a touch of wanderlust to apply to our team, as we work toward helping our travelers reach the vacation of their dreams. 

Get to know our team: 

The Marketing team operates at the intersection of business strategy, data, and execution. We build and scale programs across growth, pricing, and commercial initiatives that drive customer value and sustainable business performance globally. We’re analytical, fast-moving, and deeply cross-functional — partnering closely with Product, Finance, and other teams to shape RTA's growth agenda.

The opportunity:

We are looking for a dynamic and versatile Marketing Manager who will focus on marketing guidance and support for our white label travel platform partners. This is a strategic role where you will work closely with our Partner Managers, Product Owners and the larger Marketing team to understand the partners’ needs, advise them on impactful marketing initiatives, and drive the growth of the platform.
What you'll do:

Marketing Strategy and Execution:

Understand the partners’ business models and goals and provide expert advice on the best marketing strategies to achieve growth. Recommend initiatives to optimize campaigns and enhance platform performance for end-users.
•  Data-Driven Insights:
 Analyze large datasets to uncover trends and opportunities, delivering actionable insights that inform marketing strategies. Regularly monitor platform performance and recommend optimizations based on data findings.
•  Influencing Decision-Making:
 Guide and influence partners to adopt strategies and solutions that align with their goals as well as our business objectives. Serve as an advisor, simplifying complex marketing strategies for non-experts.
•  Revenue Growth:
 Strategically focus on maximizing contribution margin and ROI while ensuring partner satisfaction and long-term engagement.
•  Cross-Functional Collaboration:
 Work closely with internal teams, including sales, product, analytics, and operations, to ensure smooth execution and alignment of initiatives.

What you'll need to succeed:

5 years of relevant Marketing experience
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field; MBA preferred.
• Proven marketing experience, ideally within e-commerce, travel, or SaaS environments.
• Experience in a consultative or advisory role, preferably with a consulting background.
•  Strong analytical skills with the ability to dissect data and provide actionable recommendations. Basic knowledge of SQL (joins, filters, aggregates) is a must, advanced (window functions, CTEs) is a plus.
Exceptional communication, both written – clear, powerful slides – and spoken – ability to handle conversations with stakeholders and motivate them to adopt strategic decisions.
• Exposure to sales with an understanding of how partnerships contribute to revenue growth.
• Proven track record of leading multi-stakeholder initiatives successfully.

Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

Associate Brand Manager, Similac Delivery & Performance

About Abbott

Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure®, and Glucerna® – to help them get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest lives.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to :

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

The Associate Brand Manager, Similac Delivery & Performance position is based in Columbus, OH within Abbott’s Nutrition Division.

This role supports the translation of brand strategy into measurable commercial results across retail channels through strong analytical and business partnership capabilities. The ideal candidate combines experience in business analytics, forecasting, revenue management, and retail execution with marketing acumen to identify growth opportunities, optimize investments, and contribute to profitable market share growth.

The Associate Brand Manager will support commercial analytics, performance measurement, pricing architecture, assortment optimization, and demand forecasting for the Similac portfolio. This individual will leverage consumer, shopper, syndicated, financial, and retail performance data to identify opportunities, inform decision-making, and support profitable growth. This role requires a strong analytical mindset, the ability to connect insights to business actions, and effective collaboration with cross-functional partners to deliver against portfolio objectives.

What You'll Work On

Strategic & Commercial Analytics & Marketing Leadership

Serve as the business performance lead for Similac, translating data, insights, and market trends into actionable growth strategies.

Identify key consumption drivers, growth opportunities, risks, and market dynamics through analysis of consumer, shopper, retailer, and syndicated data.
Develop data-driven recommendations to maximize revenue, profitability, and market share.
Support business forecasting processes, scenario planning, and demand projections to back financial and operational decision-making.
Conduct analyses on pricing elasticity, promotional effectiveness, assortment optimization, and retail performance.

Retail Strategy & Revenue Growth Management

Evaluate distribution opportunities, whitespace opportunities, and channel expansion strategies to accelerate growth.
Optimize trade and shopper marketing investments through ROI analysis, performance measurement, and post-event evaluations.
Partner with Sales and Category Leadership to develop compelling retailer strategies and customer-facing growth stories.

Strategic Planning & Execution

Translate brand positioning and marketing strategies into actionable retail programs that drive consumer conversion and customer growth.
Partner with Innovation teams to support new product launches through business case development, launch analytics, pricing recommendations, and commercialization planning.
Develop executive-level recommendations supported by analytics and strategic rationale.
Aid in National Sales Meeting content, business planning materials, and senior leadership presentations.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Insights & Analytics, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Shopper Marketing, and Executive Leadership to drive business objectives.
Influence senior stakeholders through fact-based recommendations and strategic storytelling.
Build alignment across functions to ensure effective execution of growth initiatives and business priorities.

Required Qualifications

BA/BS degree required, preferably in Marketing, Business, Economics, Analytics or a related field.
2-5 years of experience in Brand Management, Commercial Strategy, Revenue Growth Management, Category Management, or Consumer-Packaged Goods Marketing.

Preferred Qualifications

MBA strongly preferred.
Experience with forecasting, demand planning, profitability analysis, and business performance management.
Experience analyzing syndicated data sources (Circana/IRI, Nielsen, Numerator, retailer POS data, shopper insights, etc.).
Strong financial acumen, including P&L management, pricing analysis, ROI optimization, and trade investment evaluation.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and executive storytelling capabilities.

MISC :

This is an on-site role - not a remote role.
Sponsorship : we will not provide sponsorship of any kind for this role (including OPT).
Relocation assistance is not offered for this role.

Apply Now

Job Description:

Dentsu Creative is seeking a Group Director, Social Marketing & Strategy to join our Social Marketing & Strategy team. Reporting to the VP, Head of Social Marketing & Strategy, this role will lead social strategy across a portfolio of leading CPG snack brands while serving as a trusted advisor to senior clients and a mentor to a high-performing team.

We're looking for a strategic leader who thrives in a fast-paced agency environment and brings a blend of executive presence, deep social expertise, and strong client partnership skills. The ideal candidate can confidently challenge thinking, build alignment among stakeholders, and adapt to the needs of the moment while keeping broader business objectives in focus.

This individual will help shape social strategy across key accounts, strengthen client relationships, develop and inspire talent, and identify opportunities for growth and innovation. As a member of the leadership team, they will play a pivotal role in driving impactful business results and advancing the future of social strategy for a portfolio of iconic brands.

What You'll Do

Lead social strategy across a portfolio of brands, ensuring work is strategically sound, culturally relevant, and aligned to client business goals.
Serve as a senior client partner and trusted strategic advisor, building strong relationships with senior stakeholders.
Present recommendations, business updates, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to executive-level audiences.
Partner with creative, analytics, account, influencer, and project management teams to develop integrated social marketing programs.
Oversee always-on social programs, community engagement efforts, and larger campaign initiatives across owned and earned channels.
Develop social strategies and campaign roadmaps grounded in consumer, category, and cultural insights.
Identify emerging social trends, platform opportunities, and cultural moments that can be leveraged on behalf of clients.
Drive business growth by uncovering incremental opportunities and expanding client partnerships.
Help shape staffing plans, team structures, scopes, and overall account operations.
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of approximately 15 people, including Managers, Strategists, Associate Directors, and Analytics leaders.
Provide senior-level guidance and oversight while remaining hands-on in refining and elevating strategic work.
Foster a collaborative culture that encourages creativity, accountability, and professional growth.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of experience in social marketing strategy, preferably within an agency environment.
Experience leading large-scale client relationships and serving as the day-to-day strategic lead on complex business.
Proven success building and developing high-performing teams.
Executive presence with the confidence to challenge client thinking and advocate for strategic recommendations.
Strong emotional intelligence and the ability to read a room, adapt, and influence stakeholders at all levels.
Deep understanding of social platforms, social best practices, and the evolving digital landscape.
Experience developing insight-driven strategies rooted in consumer behavior, culture, and business objectives.
Strong understanding of agency operations, including staffing, scoping, account planning, and team resourcing.
Ability to turn recommendations into actionable plans and inspire cross-functional teams to bring them to life.
Experience using social analytics and performance data to inform strategy and optimize results.
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growing business, developing talent, and pushing work to be best-in-class.

About Eleanor Health

Eleanor Health is rethinking addiction by treating it as a chronic condition and building an integrated care model that expands access to effective, whole-person treatment to drive sustained recovery. Our goal is to improve upon earlier generations of opioid and substance use disorder treatment to create more accessible clinic- and community-based care.

Eleanor Health and its associated health care providers deliver best-in-class substance use disorder care utilizing Medication-Assisted Therapy (MAT), behavioral health therapy, care management, and social support and wrap services. As a multi-site, outpatient treatment organization, Eleanor delivers accessible, evidence-based, and excellent clinical care, supported by innovative technology.

If you are passionate about growing your career in a business that makes a difference, we seek highly skilled, motivated, and compassionate individuals who take responsibility and adapt quickly to change to join our deeply committed and collaborative team.

About The Role

Every month, thousands of people decide they are ready to do something about their substance use. They search, they scroll, they stream, they click, they call, they fill out a form. This role exists to make sure that as many of them as possible find us in more places than a search results page, and that it costs less to reach them each quarter.

This is a paid media role, and it is not a paid search role. Google Ads and Microsoft Ads are our largest channels today, and a dedicated specialist runs them day to day. This role exists to build and scale everything around that foundation: affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit. We are hiring for depth in those channels, along with the website experimentation that turns more traffic into more members.

Where we are

We have built a real foundation over the past two years. Paid cost per new member has been reduced by more than half. Conversion tracking is clean and includes offline conversion data, so campaigns optimize toward people who actually enter care rather than toward form fills. Campaign structure has been rebuilt, landing page experience has improved substantially, and bid strategy and targeting have moved from manual management to value-based approaches.

This is a performance marketing function with good bones, clear measurement, and meaningful results already behind it.

Where we are going

Three priorities define the next phase of the work.

First — Paid channel diversification. Paid search carries too much of the load today. We need to build and prove affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, and to test others worth testing, so growth does not depend on a single auction that gets more expensive as we scale. Each new channel earns its budget by proving member-level economics, not lead volume.
Second — Testing rigor. Our experimentation program is young, and there is substantial gain available from running it properly: structured A/B testing on landing pages and creative, and disciplined testing of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max.
Third — Website conversion. The website is the front door for every channel. Landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience decide how much of the traffic we buy turns into a lead, and every point of lift improves every channel at once.

The channels

The channels in scope are Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. A paid search specialist runs the day-to-day on Google and Microsoft. This role leads the rest, builds the strategy across all five, and decides where each dollar goes.

How The Funnel Is Shared

Marketing does not own the entire path on its own. This role owns the path from first impression to a submitted lead or call: the channels, the landing pages, the forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. From there, our Access team is the first human point of contact for every prospective member who reaches out, by phone, by web form, or through online self-scheduling. They handle insurance verification, appointment scheduling, pre-visit support, and follow-up when someone misses an appointment. The Access team reports separately to the Chief Marketing Officer, alongside this role rather than within it.

The lifecycle communications that carry a prospective member from inquiry to first visit, including confirmations, reminders, pre-visit content, and no-show recovery, are owned by the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which also owns the content behind them. This role partners with that team and with Access, because paid cost per new member depends on what happens after the lead. A standing intake funnel review brings all three together.

What This Role Is Accountable For

The primary measure is paid cost per new member, and it is deliberately end-to-end: spend divided by members who complete a first visit, not by leads generated. It does not improve by producing more form fills. It improves when more of the people we reach actually enter care.

Alongside it sit website-visitor-to-lead conversion, owned outright by this role, and the mix of paid acquisition itself: the share of members coming from channels beyond paid search, and each new channel's cost against a defined target before it earns more budget. Lead-to-member conversion is owned by Access and the lifecycle function, and blended cost per acquisition across all channels, paid and non-paid together, sits with the Chief Marketing Officer.

What You'll Do

Paid Media Strategy & Performance

Own paid cost per new member as a quarterly target, understanding that monthly variance in this category is largely seasonal rather than performance-driven
Own budget pacing and allocation across all five channels, shifting investment toward what is working
Lead paid channel diversification: build, test, and scale affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, with a defined budget, success criteria, and scale-or-stop decision for each
Be hands-on in the newer channels: build campaigns, manage partners and platforms, and optimize against member-level outcomes rather than platform-reported leads
Manage programmatic and streaming audio partners as an informed client, including planning, creative requirements, measurement, and incrementality
Direct the paid search specialist on Google and Microsoft: set priorities, review work, and stay close enough to the accounts to audit the work independently
Design and run structured tests of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max, with clear success criteria defined before launch
Plan for seasonality: demand and cost per click vary substantially by month in addiction treatment, and the annual plan should reflect that rather than assume a flat target
Maintain offline conversion tracking and value-based bidding wherever a channel supports it, so campaigns optimize toward members rather than leads
Ensure all paid activity meets LegitScript certification and platform policy requirements for addiction treatment advertising. Meta, Reddit, and programmatic partners each apply their own restrictions

Affiliate & Partner Channels

Build and manage the affiliate program: recruit and vet partners, set terms, track quality, and cut what does not produce members
Structure affiliate and partner compensation in partnership with Legal and Compliance, including EKRA and Anti-Kickback requirements
Hold every partner to member-level quality rather than lead volume, and to our advertising and privacy standards

Website Conversion & Experimentation

Own website-visitor-to-lead conversion as a primary accountability
Build and run a disciplined experimentation program: written hypotheses, pre-declared success measures, and documented readouts including the tests that lose
Prioritize the test roadmap by expected impact rather than by ease or preference
Own the online self-scheduling experience and the forms that lead into it
Partner with the content specialist and design partners on landing page builds and publishing
Partner with the Organic & AI Acquisition team on page changes that affect both conversion and discoverability

Funnel Performance & Measurement

Maintain a view of the funnel from first impression to submitted lead, and know at all times which step is weakest
Establish and maintain a conversion baseline for every step, with methodology agreed with our data and analytics consultant
Report cost per new member and member quality by channel, including channels where tracking is imperfect, and use incrementality tests where attribution alone cannot answer the question
Participate in the standing intake funnel review with Access and the lifecycle owner, bringing the paid and website perspective
Maintain clean attribution between paid and non-paid sources
Report performance monthly against target, and explain variance without being asked

Team & Vendor Management

Direct the paid search and paid media specialists: set expectations in writing, hold a consistent feedback cadence, and develop them deliberately
Manage affiliate networks, programmatic and audio partners, and other channel vendors as an informed client
Maintain a current quarterly plan for the function showing priorities, expected impact, owners, and timelines

You'll Be a Good Fit If You

Are equally comfortable setting strategy and doing the work. This is a small team, and everyone on it executes
Have built a channel from zero: launched it, measured it honestly, and either scaled it or shut it down
Get genuinely excited by a half-point conversion lift, because you know what it compounds to across every channel
Think in terms of members rather than leads, and have turned down a cheap-lead tactic because you knew what happened downstream
Are comfortable where attribution is messy, as in affiliate, audio, and programmatic, and still hold every channel to member-level economics
Are curious about channels you have not run yet, and rigorous about how you test them
Work well inside a shared accountability, where the number depends on teams you do not manage and the only way through is a real working relationship
Are rigorous about testing: the hypothesis comes first, and the losses get reported
Find the constraints of regulated healthcare marketing energizing rather than frustrating
Can say what your team is not doing this quarter, and why
Approach the work with compassion, knowing that a faster, clearer path to care is sometimes the difference between someone entering treatment and giving up

Skills And Competencies

Experience — roughly 5+ years in performance or acquisition marketing, with at least two managing a substantial paid media budget
Channel expertise — hands-on expertise in at least three of the five channels we run: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. Real depth in at least one of affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, or Reddit, and ideally two, is essential. Paid search is covered by a specialist, so strong search skills alone are not what we are hiring for
Channel building — a record of launching a paid channel from zero and scaling it on member-level or customer-level economics rather than platform-reported conversions
Paid search literacy — enough working knowledge of Google and Microsoft Ads to direct and audit a specialist
Conversion optimization — demonstrated experience running a structured experimentation program, not just making site changes
Measurement — comfort building and defending your own reporting, measuring to the end of the funnel rather than to the lead, and handling imperfect attribution in affiliate, audio, and programmatic. Familiarity with incrementality testing
Management — experience directing specialists, contractors, or vendors. Experience managing at least one direct report is a plus
Judgment — sound decision-making in a space with hard compliance

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Column is the software platform for public information. We build automated tools and workflow solutions that help governments, law firms, and media organizations notify the public. Today, thousands of publishers and tens of thousands of agencies, firms, and individuals rely on Column to keep their communities informed every day. We’re reimagining how public information connects people, institutions, and media.

We're a remote-first team of engineers, designers, and builders who are committed to creating software that supports an informed public.

About The Role

Column | Remote (U.S.-based) | Full-Time

The Content Marketing Manager will build Column’s content engine: turning our expertise, customer stories, frontline insight, and national public notice developments into consistent, high-quality content that establishes Column as the expert on, and advocate for, public information, access to it, and public notice.

You’ll own the marketing calendar and Column’s core publishing channels, including our blog, newsletters, LinkedIn, monthly Public Notice reports, educational resources, case studies, and sales collateral. You’ll stay closely connected to our Customer Success and Services teams so our content reflects what is actually happening in the field.

As Column invests in SEO, media, partnerships, and demand generation, this role will help establish us as the definitive resource on public notice. We’re looking for a strong writer and steady operator who values quality over quantity, publishes consistently, and writes in a voice that is strong, professional, mature, and trustworthy. Candidates should also be able to move fluidly between long-form thought leadership, visual and video content, CMS publishing, and email campaigns while maintaining a consistent, high-quality publishing cadence.

What You’ll Do

Own Column’s marketing calendar and publishing cadence across the blog, newsletters, LinkedIn, email, and internal enablement, managing projects from request through drafting, review, publication, and distribution.
Follow public notice and public information news nationally, turning legislation, court decisions, industry shifts, and market trends into timely, credible content, including news commentary for our media channels.
Build a content source of truth with CSMs and our Services team (affidavits, pagination, and placement), turning their frontline knowledge into educational resources, FAQs, and enablement materials.
Write and produce high-quality content across formats, including weekly SEO blog posts, newsletters, customer case studies, guides, press releases, and sales collateral.
Own customer storytelling and case studies, from interviews and data collection through written stories, pull quotes, graphics, and video testimonials, while also supporting partnership announcements and sponsored content opportunities.
Create compelling visual and video content for marketing campaigns, social media, YouTube, reports, presentations, one-pagers, conference collateral, and other channels, bringing strong graphic design and video production/editing skills to Column’s content.
Grow Column’s LinkedIn presence and repurpose content for distribution and conversion, turning reports, customer stories, webinars, product launches, and news commentary into posts, graphics, short video, and email while improving CTAs, lifecycle campaigns, and website performance through testing.

What We’re Looking For

Exceptional writer and editor who makes complex, legal, or regulatory subjects clear and credible, with a high bar for accuracy and a mature, trustworthy voice.
Consistent, organized operator who manages an editorial calendar, juggles multiple projects, and ships on schedule without sacrificing quality.
Genuinely news-engaged, with curiosity about government, law, local media, and access to information, and the judgment to know what is worth writing about and when.
Experienced B2B content marketer with a track record of blogs, newsletters, case studies, reports, and educational resources.
Strong visual judgment and an eye for design, with experience creating polished assets such as reports, PDFs, presentations, social creative, email graphics, and sales collateral.
Digitally fluent and performance-minded, with experience publishing in a CMS, understanding SEO fundamentals, and using data, testing, and conversion insights to improve content and campaigns.
Collaborative and comfortable becoming an expert, able to interview customers, CSMs, operators, and leadership and translate what they know into clear content.

What Success Looks Like

Key Performance Indicators Will Include

Consistent publishing cadence: Approximately 1 blog post per week, 1 LinkedIn post per week, 1 newsletter per month, 1 Public Notice report per month, 1 case study per month.
Campaign and channel support: Timely press releases, webinar and lifecycle communications, conference collateral, sales enablement, and social distribution tied to major launches, partnerships, events, and customer stories.
Authority and education: Column’s blog, reports, and resources become a go-to reference on public notice and public information, and Sales, CSMs, and Services actively use them. You also establish a reliable monthly loop with internal teams to surface trends, customer questions, and field insights into published content.
Audience growth: Growth in organic traffic, newsletter engagement, LinkedIn followers and engagement, and gated resource downloads.
Business impact: Clear attribution between content and pipeline, showing which blogs, newsletters, reports, case studies, and posts generate and influence marketing leads.
Editorial execution: Maintain a clear content calendar, independently manage recurring workflows. Ensure content moves efficiently from idea through publication and distribution.
Content repurposing: Major webinars, research, case studies, product education, and customer conversations are consistently turned into multiple useful formats across web, email, LinkedIn, video, and sales enablement.

Your First 90 Days

First 60 Days: Learn Column and Build the Foundation

The first 60 days focus on learning Column’s products, customers, voice, and the public notice ecosystem, while quickly contributing to our content engine.

You Will

Learn Column’s products, customer segments, positioning, marketing priorities, and the public notice landscape
Review our existing blogs, newsletters, case studies, email programs, and sales enablement
Take over the Marketing Calendar, Marketing Requests, and recurring content workflows
Set up a regular check-in with CSMs and Services team to source insights and stories
Build a news-monitoring routine for public notice legislation and public information developments

By Day 60, You Will Have

Published 2 blog posts
Published 2 newsletters
Published 1 customer case study
Published 2 LinkedIn posts
Published 1 Public Notice report
Responded to and managed incoming content and marketing requests
Actively maintained and managed the Marketing Calendar

By the end of your second month, you understand Column’s voice, audience, products, and priorities—and can independently own standard content projects from request through publication.

Days 61-90: Own and Build

By your third month, you are independently running Column’s content engine: a weekly blog, newsletters, the monthly Public Notice report, steady LinkedIn publishing, and timely news commentary for Glorion.

By Day 90, you have published a second monthly Public Notice report, built a repeatable process with CSMs and Services for sourcing content, and established a consistent, recognizable Column voice across every channel.

Must Haves

2+ years of experience in content marketing, B2B marketing, editorial, journalism, communications, or a related field
Excellent writing, editing, research, and interviewing skills, with experience producing substantive long-form content
Strong visual judgment and experience creating polished marketing assets in Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools
Strong project management skills, including managing editorial calendars, multiple stakeholders, and competing deadlines
A track record of publishing on a consistent cadence and owning projects from idea through distribution

Nice to Haves

Experience with lifecycle marketing platforms like Customer.io and website tools like Framer
Deeper experience with B2B SEO, original research, and A/B-tested email campaigns
Experience covering legal, policy, or government news, or building a LinkedIn audience for a B2B brand
Experience supporting PR, sponsored content, media, or industry partnerships
Familiarity with government technology, legal technology, local media, public notice, or another regulated industry

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary: $80k-$100k based on experience
401K with match
Health, dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability insurance
Flexible PTO and fully remote work environment (U.S.-based)

jobs.description:
About Vasion

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

About The Role

Our partner go-to-market motion is growing fast, and it needs someone to set its messaging strategy and build the processes that drive it. As the Product Marketing Manager, Channel & Ecosystem, you will decide how Vasion tells its story through MSPs, VARs, and technology alliances, and how we take our value into new channels like system integrators and a Vasion Marketplace. You connect what our products can do to what each channel needs to hear, then turn the work into repeatable templates and standards.

If you are a product marketer or a channel marketer who wants to flex your process-building and scaling muscle, this is the seat for it. You will work with product managers, partner marketing, and our partner teams on a lot of fun projects with a lot of great people.

Life on the PMM Team

The PMM team is a close-knit, high-performing group that takes on hard problems together and makes sure everyone succeeds along the way. We take the work seriously and enjoy doing it, and that shows in how we collaborate, whether in the office or remote. You will work alongside some of the strongest product marketers, who will support your growth and help turn complex, unstructured problems into clear results. Current and former team members regularly describe it as “ one of the best teams of their careers” .

Your First 90 Days

Meet the team and your core stakeholders.
Take over the partner workstreams, with every in-flight project matched to an owner.
Finalize the Partner Messaging Framework and core go-to-market packages..
Build AI skills specific to our channel strategy, messaging, and sales plays. These connect colleagues across the company to the right resources and guide them in their own work.
Put one standard process in place for all priority partners: kickoff, messaging alignment, execution, enablement, and launch.

Responsibilities

Set the go-to-market strategy and messaging for each partner channel, including MSPs, VARs, and technology alliances, and help define the motion for system integrators and the Vasion Marketplace.
Build a working understanding of our partnerships, personas, competitors, and market through research and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Own the joint value proposition and narrative. Write the "better together" story so it is clear, differentiated, and credible to the partner and its buyers, aligned across both companies, and mutually beneficial.
Own the standard launch process for priority partners and keep it running on a calendar.
Create partner enablement assets, including co-branded content, solution briefs, pitch decks, joint case studies, and campaign-in-a-box kits. Build them so partner teams can sell and market with us at scale without our help, then track the impact for the partner ad Vasion.
Coordinate joint announcements and amplify Vasion product launches and major industry moments through partners.
Build and refine AI skills and shared systems for channel messaging and sales plays.
Report partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline. When no baseline exists, pick a small set of leading indicators and say so when the signal is weak.
Maintain strong relationships in partner organizations and across Vasion.
Be the voice of the ecosystem and channel partners internally. Gather feedback from partners and partner-facing sellers, and represent partner requirements with evidence in product and marketing roadmap discussions.
Act as a product expert and advocate for sellers, partners, customers, and colleagues inside Vasion.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field. MBA is a plus.
Three or more years of experience in B2B marketing, preferably in product, partner, alliance, or ecosystem marketing, and preferably in a tech or SaaS environment.
A proven record running joint go-to-market with technology and ISV partners, cloud providers, managed service providers, or system integrators.
A compelling storyteller and communicator. You build joint narratives that are crisp, differentiated, and credible to partners and their buyers, and you explain the product with energy and accuracy.
Highly curious with the ability to turn research into a point of view others use.
A go-to-market builder with an analytical streak.
A trusted collaborator and self-starter.

Preferred, But Not Required

MSP and VAR channel models, and PRM or portal tools (MindMatrix today)
Salesforce, Seismic, Pendo, and Notion
Cloud marketplace listing and co-sell concepts
SI engagement models

Benefits

Flexible work environment
Vacation Bonus
Flexible paid time off
Paid parental leave
Competitive pay
A full suite of traditional benefits
Training/Advancement opportunities
401k with company match and immediate vesting
Financial wellness education
Company-contributed HSA
On-site perks include gym, pickleball, snacks & drinks, arcade, theater room, etc.

Our Core Values

Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become:

Disruptive Visionaries: Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers.
Relationship Builders: We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication.
Candor Seekers: Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly.
Action Owners: Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance.

More About Vasion

Visit https://www.vasion.com to learn more about Vasion.

Additional Information

Vasion is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation and other legally protected characteristics.

About The Role

Optimal is seeking an SEO & GEO Strategist with a passion for the evolving intersection of search, AI, and brand visibility. This role is ideal for someone who understands traditional SEO fundamentals but is eager to help brands win in the next era of discovery: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

As part of Optimal’s innovative SEO team, you’ll influence how brands are surfaced and represented across both search engines and LLMs, from Google’s AI Overviews to ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc. Our team combines technical SEO, industry-leading content strategy, and digital PR with forward-thinking GEO tactics that shape visibility and sentiment across the full spectrum of modern discovery.

Who Are We?

Optimal is a performance marketing agency on a mission, bringing together the best data, technology, and people to achieve our clients’ marketing goals. Brand, campaign, or cause: we maximize performance at every moment.

We are not only digital media strategists – we’re award-winning industry leaders, with deep knowledge spanning all things digital: from advertising and paid media, to marketing and communications, to audience data and analytics, we deliver for our clients.

Everyone at Optimal has the opportunity to learn, grow, and progress. Through our proprietary training programs, we provide our team members with the personal and professional development they need to achieve advancement at any stage in their careers.

We’re always looking for exceptional people to join our team. If this sounds like you, please apply!

Essential Functions, Duties, And Responsibilities

Produce high-quality, research-driven content engineered for both human audiences and LLMs, enhancing visibility across search engines and generative platforms.
Conduct comprehensive SEO and GEO audits to identify opportunities for growth across Google Search, AI Overviews, and LLMs.
Perform LLM visibility and sentiment audits to understand how brands are represented within AI outputs and surface actionable recommendations to improve authority, trust, and visibility.
Implement on-page SEO optimizations, including metadata, internal linking, schema markup, and entity structuring to strengthen machine understanding and topical relevance.
Collaborate with developers to execute technical enhancements such as redirects, canonicalization, structured data validation, and Core Web Vitals improvements that ensure full crawlability and AI readability.
Analyze and report on performance through traditional analytics tools and emerging GEO visibility platforms, translating findings into actionable insights that improve both search and LLM outcomes.
Stay ahead of evolving AI trends by testing and documenting GEO best practices that influence how brands appear across LLMs.

Minimum Qualifications & Skill Requirements

2+ years of relevant SEO experience
4-year Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Journalism, Analytics, English/Writing, or Communications; or relevant experience through school and/or internships
An analytical mindset with the ability to extract actionable insights from data and translate them into clear SEO + GEO recommendations.
Understanding of how LLMs and generative search are reshaping SEO visibility, brand representation, and discovery paths.
Familiarity with AI visibility and prompt-tracking tools (e.g., Peec.ai, Profound, or equivalent) to measure performance within generative platforms.
Experience using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and keyword tracking tools to evaluate performance and uncover growth opportunities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex SEO + AI insights for clients and internal stakeholders.
Solid grasp of technical SEO components such as schema, canonicals, Core Web Vitals, and XML sitemaps
Experience with SEO platforms and tools (e.g. Ahrefs, SEMrush, etc.)
Eagerness to expand into GEO and AI-driven content strategy, staying ahead of how search engines and LLMs interpret brand authority.
Proficiency with Excel / Google Sheets for data analysis and reporting; basic familiarity with HTML and CSS is a plus.

Optimal Is Proud To Offer The Following

Flexible Time Off
Paid Leave for New Parents
Health insurance (including dental and vision)
Flex Spending Plan
Employee Assistance Program
401K with company matching
Tuition Reimbursement
Professional development opportunities
Rewards and recognition programs

Office Hours

This role is based out of our Austin office. Our Austin team works on a hybrid basis, with three days per week working in the office and two days per week working from home. Work hours are consistently 9:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M., Monday - Friday, with the expectation that evening and weekend work will be required as necessary.
