jobs.title: Tourism and Creative Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Full Salary Ranges:
$89,017.24- 129,075.00 Annually

Anticipated Hiring Ranges:
$89,017.24- $112,091.20 Annually

Why do I see two salary ranges?

The City of Greeley in compliance with Colorado state law, includes a salary range for all positions posted. This law is intended to improve wage transparency. The City of Greeley, in support of wage transparency, posts both the full salary range for each position (what you might anticipate your earnings could be if you work for the City of Greeley for some time), as well as the anticipated hiring range (the range within which the City anticipates making an offer). The actual offer extended will be based on your years of relevant experience, education, certifications and potentially other factors.

City of Greeley's Total Rewards

The City of Greeley is committed to providing a comprehensive total rewards program that supports employees in their work by encouraging excellence andinvesting in employee development and recognition. This philosophy is grounded in fiscal responsibility, organizational effectiveness, and employee safety and well-being, ensuring the responsible stewardship of public resources while offering meaningful and comparable rewards. This approach ensures that the city remains an attractive, inclusive, and rewarding work environment, while also effectively serving the community.

Benefits:
This position is benefits eligible. Please view our benefits guide here .

Job Summary

The Tourism and Creative Marketing Manager leads the City of Greeley’s destination marketing operation and the Communication & Engagement department’s creative production team. This position is responsible for Greeley tourism strategy, the Lodgers Tax–funded tourism budget, VisitGreeley.com, and annual planning for destination marketing, while also supervising the video and graphic design team that produces creative for tourism, citywide campaigns, and City departments.

As both strategist and implementer, this position sets the direction for how Greeley is positioned and promoted as a destination—to leisure travelers, meeting and convention planners, sports and event organizers, and group travel—and then carries that strategy through to market. The role develops the annual tourism marketing plan and budget; manages agency, vendor, and media buys; builds partnerships with hotels, attractions, businesses, event organizers, and regional and state tourism partners; and measures results against clear goals for visitation, lodging, and return on investment. The role also serves as the department’s lead for brand standards and creative quality, ensuring video, graphics, photography, and campaign assets are strategic, on brand, accessible, and delivered on time.

This position requires strong leadership, sound fiscal judgment, and the ability to move between big-picture planning and hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities, seasonal timelines, and competing demands. The Tourism and Creative Marketing Manager must be able to build and coach a high-performing creative team, set clear priorities and intake processes, make informed decisions, and adjust strategy based on data, market trends, and partner needs to grow visitation and strengthen perceptions of Greeley.

Minimum Requirements

Experience, Education, and Skills:

Bachelor’s degree gained through a four-year college/university academic program or specialized technical training of equivalent length in marketing, communications, tourism or hospitality management, business, or a related field.
No less than seven years of progressively responsible professional experience in destination marketing, tourism, marketing, or creative/brand management, including at least three years supervising staff or leading a creative team.
Demonstrated experience developing and managing a marketing budget, including planning, forecasting, tracking expenditures, and reporting.
Experience developing and executing annual marketing plans and integrated, multi-channel campaigns (paid, owned, earned, social, and digital).
Experience directing video production and graphic design work, including creative briefs, art direction, production scheduling, and quality review.
Experience managing agencies, vendors, contracts, and media buys.
Proficient in project management to successfully schedule, lead, and deliver multiple campaigns and projects at once.
Experience using data and analytics (e.g., web analytics, social media metrics, lodging and visitor data) to measure performance and report outcomes.
Strong verbal and written communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Experience with Microsoft Office 365 and Microsoft Teams, and familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud, website content management systems, and social media management platforms.
Ability to travel occasionally, including overnight, for trade shows, sales missions, and industry conferences.

OR

Any combination of related education, experience, certifications and licenses that will result in a candidate successfully performing the essential functions of the job,

AND

Possession of a valid driver’s license.

Preferred

Experience working in or with a destination marketing organization (DMO), convention and visitors bureau, or public-sector tourism program funded by lodging tax.
Certified Destination Management Executive (CDME), Professional in Destination Management (PDM), or similar industry credential.
Familiarity with Colorado Tourism Office programs, grants, and cooperative marketing opportunities.
Experience with tourism research and data tools, such as lodging performance reports and visitor location data.
Hands-on skills in video production, photography, or graphic design.
Bilingual in Spanish preferred, but not required.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Experience with strategy and operations -comfortable setting direction and then rolling up their sleeves to deliver the work.
Understand destination marketing and the visitor economy, including how tourism supports local businesses, the City’s revenue, and community pride.
Be a confident, supportive people leader who builds a collaborative, accountable, and creative team culture.
Be fiscally responsible and comfortable managing public funds with transparency and accountability.
Use data to make decisions and to tell the story of results.

jobs.description:

: Part-time at 10 hours/week (with possible opportunity to scale in the future)

: Set your own schedule anytime between 8:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m., Monday – Friday
Location
: 5330 Park Avenue, Suite 202, Memphis, TN 38119
Compensation & Benefits
: $25/hr, 6 weeks annual PTO, flexible schedule, family-friendly work environment

----------------------------

Position Overview

ExploriGuides is a camp curriculum startup seeking an innovative Sales & Marketing Manager to develop creative ways to put our resources in the hands of camp directors. This position will pair inventive campaign thinking with strategic planning—all while keeping a pulse on what motivates a camp director to say “yes!” We are looking for someone to join our team who is passionate about our mission, brings energy, and can help ExploriGuides launch and grow through playful storytelling. 

The ideal candidate has a proven track record and must possess exceptional writing skills, a creative spirit, and the ability to translate imaginative ideas into meaningful marketing campaigns that bring in sales. Some knowledge of camp, youth development, education, or after-school industry is strongly preferred.

----------------------------

Primary Responsibilities

Manage email marketing, social media, and website messaging
Coordinate promotions and seasonal campaigns
Identify and pursue prospects, and manage the pipeline from first contact to close
Serve as a point of contact for customers, responding promptly and warmly to questions and issues
Develop pricing tiers, bulk and multi-site discounts, and early-bird offers
Track leads, conversions, and revenue in a simple CRM and report on them monthly
Develop and execute a creative, data-informed marketing plan aligned to the camp buying cycle
Collect and share testimonials, case studies, and camper and counselor feedback
Build relationships with camp associations, youth-serving organizations, and complementary vendors
Monitor competitors and market trends and bring strategic recommendations on product and positioning
Share customer feedback with the curriculum team to inform new product development
Work closely with the owner and other key members to develop and refine strategy as the company grows
Other duties as assigned and agreed upon by both parties

----------------------------

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or higher in marketing, business administration, communication, or a related field
The strongest candidates will have experience with email and social media marketing, and will have a proven track record in generating revenue
Experience in the camp, youth development, education, or after-school industry strongly preferred

----------------------------

Core Competencies & Skills

Excellent verbal skills, and exceptional written communication skills - the ability to write clearly, engagingly, and with a distinct voice is essential to this role
Excellent computer proficiency (Google suite and relevant software)
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
Creative thinker with the ability to develop imaginative, playful marketing strategies with limited resources
Working knowledge of email marketing platforms, social media tools, and a CRM
Collaborative working style with a willingness to tinker, iterate, and try new approaches
Comfortable working in a startup environment with evolving processes and close collaboration with leadership

----------------------------

To Apply

To apply, email your resume to Amy Lee at basecamp@exploriguides.com and tell us:

Why you’d be a great fit
What your favorite children’s book is
Your favorite marketing campaign you’ve worked on
Any experience/knowledge you have in or of the camp, youth development, education, or after-school industry

----------------------------

Want to learn more? 

Because we are an early-stage start-up, our website is still under construction. Read below to learn more about ExploriGuides or email Amy at basecamp@exploriguides.com to chat in more detail.

----------------------------

About ExploriGuides

ExploriGuides is a curriculum startup founded by camp pro Amy Lee, a former out-of-school childcare director and school administrator with a vision to bring extraordinary programming to camps everywhere. We’re on a mission to create hands-on experiences, wild experiments, and projects that spark imagination, inspire innovation, and invite joyful play. Our curriculums are designed specifically for out-of-school spaces – camps, after-school programs, enrichment classes, and clubs.

Extraordinary Adventures. Effortlessly Planned.

----------------------------

Our Educational Philosophy

At ExploriGuides, we believe children learn best through play. We value hands-on, experiential learning that encourages questions, celebrates curiosity, and emphasizes the process of learning over producing a perfect end result. We believe some of the most meaningful growth happens when children have the freedom to tinker, experiment, imagine, create through joyful exploration.

Above all, we believe summer camp should be wildly fun. Joy isn’t separate from learning – it’s what makes learning memorable. The laughter, friendships, shared discoveries, and unforgettable moments children experience at camp build confidence, foster a love of learning, and create memories that last long after summer ends. Our goal is to help every child leave camp feeling curious, capable, connected, and excited to keep exploring.

----------------------------

Our Commitment to Inclusion

ExploriGuides is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every individual is treated with dignity and respect. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, cultures, abilities, faiths or no faiths, family structures, and lived experiences because we believe diverse perspectives strengthen our team and help us better serve the children, educators, and communities who inspire our work. We are committed to creating products and a workplace where all children, families, and educators feel seen, respected, and valued.

Our mission is to create meaningful learning experiences that reflect the richness and diversity of the world children live in. We value team members who embrace that mission and are excited to help create thoughtful, welcoming materials that celebrate different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives with authenticity, care, and respect.

The Experiential Services Intern will support the Kroger Experiential Strategy & Innovation team in developing customer-focused, in-store, and event-based experiences that help brands and Kroger drive product trial, engagement, and sales. This opportunity is designed for a curious, business-minded student interested in experiential marketing, shopper insights, strategic planning, and client engagement.

Analyze historical program participation to identify whitespace opportunities across manufacturers, categories, and brands.
Develop recommendations that may increase experiential program participation and client engagement.

Translate research and performance findings into practical insights and recommendations for future programs and client conversations.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners and participate in team meetings, strategic discussions, and client-related projects.
Own a substantive summer project and present findings, recommendations, and proposed business impact to Kroger Experiential leadership.
Perform other duties and project work as assigned based on evolving business needs.

Qualifications
Currently enrolled in an accredited four-year degree-granting institution or accredited graduate, master’s, or MBA program in the United States.
Rising junior, rising senior, or graduate student during the internship period.
Pursuing a degree in marketing, business administration, communications, advertising, consumer insights, market research, analytics, retail studies, or a related field.
Minimum 3.0 GPA.
Ability to research business questions, identify patterns, and connect findings to practical recommendations.
Ability to communicate ideas and analytical findings clearly through written materials and presentations.
Curiosity, coachability, learning agility, and interest in shopper, retail, or experiential marketing.
Ability to organize work independently, manage multiple priorities, ask thoughtful questions, and communicate proactively.

Preferred Skills and Attributes
Interest in experiential marketing, shopper marketing, retail strategy, brand activation, consumer behavior, or client services.
Experience completing a class, academic, internship, or work project involving research, analysis, marketing strategy, or recommendations.
Proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; exposure to Microsoft Forms or Asana is helpful.
Strong storytelling, presentation, market research, problem-solving, and professional communication skills.
Comfort working with ambiguity, synthesizing information, and collaborating across functions.

Summer Project Deliverables
Experiential annual planning calendar highlighting key retailer and shopper moments.
Trend and opportunity assessment identifying future experiential growth areas.
Manufacturer and category opportunity database, including a priority prospect list with supporting rationale.
Recommendations for increasing participation across experiential programs.
Updated experiential opportunity toolkit and client-facing presentation materials.
Best-practice library featuring successful experiential case studies and program examples.
Executive-level capstone presentation summarizing findings, recommendations, and proposed business impact.

Work Environment and Program Experience

Cincinnati is the preferred location because the role will benefit from participation in team meetings, strategic discussions, and client-related projects. Candidates in Atlanta, Dallas, or St. Louis may also be considered based on business needs and the final working arrangement.
The 10-week summer experience includes meaningful manager-led work, regular coaching and feedback, exposure to cross-functional teams, access to historical program data and planning resources, internship programming, and a final capstone experience.

This position does not have direct or indirect supervisory responsibilities.

Work is performed primarily in an office or sedentary environment and requires regular use of a computer and communication technology. The intern must be able to perform the essential functions of the role, with reasonable accommodations provided as required by applicable law.

We help purpose-driven individuals

achieve their goals through writing and publishing books. Our mission: help 100,000 people publish a book by 2035

, impacting 120M+ lives

through what we call Leveraged Impact. (You can hear more about it in our TEDx talk).

in online education because we genuinely care...about our authors, their stories, and the ripple effect they create.

💡 It’s not about the book. It’s about what the book does for you.
🚀 Self-publishing isn’t just an option...it’s the best option.

We’re proud to have been named to the INC 5000 list

of America’s fastest-growing private companies in 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2022.

And we’re just getting started.

Do you love organizing, anticipating needs, and keeping things running seamlessly? We’re looking for a rockstar Executive Assistant to support our CEO so he can stay focused on high-impact, strategic work.

This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves solving problems, and gets energy from helping others succeed.

About The Role

Do you have a camera roll full of edits, a notes app full of hooks, and a real curiosity about how brands grow online?

Then please read on…

selfpublishing.com is a back-to-back-to-back INC 5000

company & we're launching our Summer 2027 Social Media Internship Program

. Our mission is to TRANSFORM THE LIVES of authors by helping them write and publish books, grow their businesses, and launch their author careers!

This is an in-person summer internship based in our Westlake (Austin) office. You'll create real content for two brands: selfpublishing.com and our CEO Chandler Bolt's personal brand. Your work won't sit in a folder. It gets posted.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be part of the team that plans, films, edits, and ships content every week. Your north stars? Making scroll-stopping short-form content and learning exactly why it works. 🌱

More Specifically, You'll

🎬Create original short-form content (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts) for two brands: selfpublishing.com and our CEO Chandler Bolt's personal brand
✂️Edit and repurpose existing long-form content, including podcast episodes and YouTube videos, into short clips for both brands
✍️Write captions, hooks, and on-screen text that match each brand's voice
🎥Help plan and film content in our Austin office, including behind-the-scenes, founder content with Chandler, and team moments
🔍Research trending formats, sounds, and creators in the author, book, and entrepreneurship spaces, and pitch new ideas
📅Schedule and post content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Facebook
📊Track performance on your posts and share what's working in weekly check-ins
💬Engage with our communities by replying to comments and DMs

What You'll Learn

🧠How a real content team plans, produces, and ships content every week
🌿How to grow a company brand and a founder's personal brand side by side, and how they work differently
🎞️Short-form editing and storytelling that holds attention
📈How to read analytics and turn data into better content
💸How social media drives real business results

Who We're Looking For

Students studying marketing, communications, film, journalism, or a related field
You know how to edit, whether that’s on your phone (CapCut, InShot) or your computer (Premiere, Final Cut, or similar)
You’re a creator yourself, or at least deeply creative, and you love telling stories
You’re the person who’s always saving videos to recreate later or sending yourself hooks you like
You’re into entrepreneurship and business building, or you love reading, writing, and books (bonus if it’s both)
Self-starter who can take feedback and turn work around fast
Bonus: a portfolio, personal page, or any content you’ve made

jobs.description:
The Digital Marketing Strategist leads and coordinates integrated digital marketing initiatives for Insurance Marketing, supporting performance and brand objectives across Auto, Home, and Life Insurance.

The role is centered on three core pillars: strategic testing, user experience, and advertising operations and technology. This individual connects marketing, creative, media, analytics, technology, and agency partners to move initiatives from strategy through execution.

The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter who takes ownership, manages projects from beginning to end, and adapts effectively in a rapidly changing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Testing

Develop and manage a strategic testing roadmap aligned with marketing and business priorities.
Identify A/B and multivariate testing opportunities across digital campaigns, audiences, creative, landing pages, and customer journeys.
Partner with marketing, creative, media, analytics, and technology teams to define test objectives, hypotheses, success metrics, and implementation requirements.
Coordinate tests from initial concept and setup through launch, analysis, and recommendations.
Translate test results into actionable insights that inform future campaigns and digital experiences.
Maintain visibility into testing priorities, results, learnings, and next steps.

User Experience

Evaluate digital customer journeys, landing pages, forms, and online experiences to improve usability, engagement, and conversion.
Identify customer pain points and opportunities to strengthen the end-to-end digital experience.
Coordinate web and UX initiatives, including requirements, content updates, testing, quality assurance, and launch readiness.
Partner with creative, analytics, product, and technology teams to translate business and customer needs into digital solutions.
Ensure digital experiences align with campaign objectives, brand standards, and measurement requirements.

Ad Operations & Technology

Coordinate paid media execution across search, social, programmatic, display, and video.
Manage ad operations, including campaign setup, trafficking, tracking, creative delivery, quality assurance, and launch readiness.
Partner with internal teams and agencies to align audiences, creative, budgets, timelines, landing pages, and measurement.
Support the implementation and validation of pixels, tags, URLs, and conversion tracking.
Troubleshoot campaign delivery, tracking, creative, and landing-page issues.
Support new digital marketing tools, vendors, integrations, pilots, and technology capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve campaign workflows, operational processes, and marketing technology utilization.

Digital Initiative Leadership

Lead cross-functional digital initiatives by defining requirements, establishing ownership, coordinating stakeholders, and resolving roadblocks.
Manage project plans, workflows, deliverables, dependencies, and status updates in Monday.com.
Establish repeatable processes and documentation that improve visibility, accountability, and execution.
Monitor campaign and digital performance and translate results into actionable recommendations.
Manage multiple priorities while maintaining momentum as business needs evolve.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, digital media, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in digital marketing, strategic testing, UX, web, paid media, ad operations, marketing technology, or campaign management.
Experience developing or supporting A/B and multivariate testing programs.
Experience coordinating integrated campaigns and cross-functional projects.
Working knowledge of digital customer journeys, website optimization, paid media, campaign tracking, and performance measurement.
Experience with Monday.com or a similar work management platform.
Strong organizational, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Proactive self-starter with the ability to take ownership and manage projects from concept through completion.
Ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and adjust quickly in a rapidly changing environment.

What Success Looks Like

A strategic testing roadmap is established and produces actionable learnings.
Testing insights improve campaigns, customer journeys, and digital experiences.
UX initiatives reduce friction and improve engagement and conversion.
Paid media campaigns launch accurately, on time, and with appropriate tracking.
Monday.com provides a clear, reliable view of project priorities, ownership, timelines, dependencies, and progress.

jobs.description:
Company Description
Three Little Pigs Investment Services is an investment firm specializing in Cincinnati real estate, focusing on the acquisition, management, and optimization of residential investment properties. The organization is committed to delivering reliable, data-driven real estate services and building long-term value for clients and investors. Team members gain exposure to the full investment lifecycle, from property analysis to marketing and tenant engagement.

Role Description

Edit the podcast: The Cincinnati Real Estate Investing Show

Help edit each weekly episode in Descript: clean up the audio, cut mistakes and dead air, add the intro and outro, and export for audio and YouTube.
Write show notes and timestamps for each episode.
Pull 3 to 5 short clips (10 to 45 seconds) from each episode within 3 days of release.

Grow our Instagram: @yourhouseofbricks, @thecincyreishow, @cincyreiweek

Edit reels from podcast clips, event footage and on-camera videos, with captions, tight cuts and a strong first two seconds. Cross-post to Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts.
Create engagement: reply to comments and messages within one business day, comment on posts from local businesses, meetup hosts and investors in our community, and run stories, polls and questions.
Pass any question about investing with us to the team. Never answer it yourself.
Keep each account's profile, pinned posts and links current. Our main accounts are @cincycashflow, @yourhouseofbricks and @thecincyreishow, plus TLP Property Management's pages.

Make videos

Edit long-form videos and short reels that promote our podcast, events and education programs, and tell the stories of investors in our community.
Use AI tools (we use Claude, Descript and Canva) to work faster, and check every cut, caption and fact yourself before it goes to review.
Shoot one or two field days a week: neighborhoods, local businesses, landmarks and city events that show investors what living and owning property in Cincinnati is like.
Film our properties: renovations in progress, before-and-after shots, finished units and tours, scheduled with our property management team.
Keep a b-roll library in Google Drive, sorted by neighborhood, property and date, so anyone on the team can find a clip in a minute.

Promote our events

Promote the Best Ever Meetup, other local real estate meetups and the monthly Bay Area meetup Ian co-hosts: event graphics, posts, stories, listings and reminder emails.
Film at events from a shot list and post a recap reel
Help put together swag bags for events and investors, and help write and send holiday cards.

Write the newsletter, blog and emails

Help write, design and assemble each issue of the newsletter.
Write blog posts on real estate, market trends and the questions investors search for. Optimize each one for search engines (SEO) and for AI answer tools such as ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews (GEO).
Create blog graphics from our branded template, plus flyers and other marketing materials in Canva.
Support email marketing: build campaigns, draft email copy and segment email lists in GoHighLevel.

Research what is next

Follow industry trends, competitor accounts and new topics, and turn them into timely blog posts and reels.
Stay current on digital marketing practices and new tools.
Research competitors and market trends to find content that brings in more newsletter sign-ups, meetup guests and members for our investing community.

Report on results

Build a monthly report across channels: website traffic, email open and click rates, conversion rates (sign-ups and RSVPs), and the return on the time and money we spent.
Suggest one new idea or format each week, based on what the numbers show.

What you bring

A current college student.
A digital portfolio or strong examples of your past work: videos, reels, graphics or writing. Links are fine.
Video editing skills on your phone or laptop (CapCut, Descript, Premiere, Final Cut or similar).
Clear, simple writing for captions, blog posts and emails.

Preferred

An understanding of real estate or real estate investing.
Podcast or audio editing experience.
Experience with SEO, blog writing or email marketing tools.
Experience with Canva, Notion, Meta Business Suite or GoHighLevel.
Photography skills.
For a Cincinnati resident: knowledge of Cincinnati neighborhoods and local businesses.

Oversee the strategy and execution of global and regional product launches, lifecycle campaigns, and flagship programs—setting new industry benchmarks for impact and creativity.
Align closely with Brand, Creative, Digital, Regional, E-commerce, Sales and GTM teams for unified market entry and sustained success.
Constantly evaluate and optimize marketing strategies, investments and program performance—analyzing KPIs, market trends, and competitive intelligence to drive growth.

Elevate Logitech G’s presence within the global gaming ecosystem through partnerships with esports, creators, and thought leaders.
Serve as an external evangelist and internal champion—spotlighting Logitech G’s innovation, culture, and vision at industry events and across media.

Product & Insight Excellence

Anticipate and define market shifts, emerging segments, and white-space opportunities—fueling bold, data-driven bets.
Drive the cadence and discipline of market, consumer, and product insight gathering—fueling continuous improvement and breakthrough ideas.

Gamer with avid engagement and experience of the community & industry.
Exceptional experience (approx 12+ years) in progressive product marketing management roles, including executive marketing leadership roles.

for internal meetings & team events, industry conferences (as required/needed), and on-site events.

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Chief Marketing Officer based in the United States.

As Chief Marketing Officer, you will lead the marketing strategy and execution for a global membership, education, events, and community business serving go-to-market (GTM) professionals. You will oversee product marketing, lifecycle marketing, performance marketing, brand and content, digital experience, and sales enablement, with direct accountability for driving new bookings and renewals. As a member of the executive leadership team, you will translate business objectives into clear priorities, budgets, and measurable growth initiatives. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines strategic decision-making with practical execution, team development, and cross-functional collaboration. You will optimize acquisition and retention, strengthen positioning across B2C and B2B offerings, and leverage AI-powered workflows to improve marketing efficiency and performance. The ideal candidate is a commercially minded marketing leader who can build high-performing teams, make disciplined investment decisions, and deliver measurable business outcomes in a flexible, remote-friendly environment.

Accountabilities

You will own the overall marketing strategy, budget, and execution, ensuring that marketing initiatives directly contribute to new customer acquisition, renewal revenue, and growth across the organization's membership, education, events, and business offerings.

Marketing Strategy and Executive Leadership: Translate business objectives into marketing priorities, initiatives, performance metrics, and resource plans. Partner with executive leadership to establish priorities across products, audiences, and markets, and secure alignment on the decisions needed to achieve business goals.
Cross-Functional Accountability: Hold executive peers accountable for agreed objectives and commitments. Identify dependencies, address competing priorities, and ensure decisions reflect the team's capacity and business needs.
Team Leadership and Development: Lead and develop teams across product marketing, lifecycle marketing, performance marketing, and sales enablement. Establish clear responsibilities, provide constructive feedback, recognize results, and recommend hiring or agency support when appropriate.
Performance Measurement and Reporting: Establish regular performance reviews with leadership, Finance, and Revenue Operations (RevOps). Maintain consistent definitions of bookings and dashboards that distinguish cash collected from pipeline and unpaid commitments.
Growth Strategy and Budget Management: Own the marketing plan and budget against agreed bookings targets, accounting for new membership acquisition, renewals, and B2B revenue. Allocate resources based on cash bookings, customer acquisition costs, retention, and payback periods.
Performance Marketing: Direct paid media, search engine optimization (SEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), and event acquisition initiatives. Evaluate campaigns using hands-on expertise, challenge agency recommendations when necessary, and optimize performance against commercial objectives.
Channel and Geographic Expansion: Test new acquisition channels for reaching GTM professionals globally. Establish clear criteria for scaling, revising, or discontinuing investments, aligned with geographic priorities and the organization's Chapter model.
AI and Marketing Operations: Identify opportunities to deploy AI agents and automated workflows for content production, audience segmentation, reporting, lead scoring, and other marketing processes. Establish measurable success criteria and ensure responsible adoption, clear ownership, and appropriate quality control.
Lifecycle Marketing and Retention: Lead programs that improve member activation, engagement, upgrades, and renewals. Use behavioral insights and cohort performance to guide decisions and strengthen recurring revenue.
Member Engagement and Renewal Programs: Collaborate with Member Success and program teams on onboarding, nurture campaigns, milestone communications, renewal outreach, and member handoffs. Develop referral, upgrade, and win-back initiatives informed by member feedback and retention barriers.
Lead Nurturing and Conversion: Own conversion-focused lifecycle journeys that help interested GTM professionals progress from initial engagement to purchasing memberships, courses, and other offerings.
Product Marketing and Positioning: Lead product marketing and conversion rate optimization (CRO) across B2C and B2B offerings. Define target audiences, positioning, value propositions, and the reasons customers should purchase or renew.
Go-to-Market Planning: Clarify how membership, education, events, and team solutions fit together. Develop launch plans for courses sold independently and through membership, coordinating timing and customer transitions with learning teams.
B2B Marketing: Own the strategy and execution for marketing courses sold in bulk to businesses, including buyer messaging, demand generation, and support for team and company purchases. Work with Sales to improve pipeline quality and conversion into cash bookings.
Sales Enablement and Conversion: Lead the team responsible for direct follow-up with prospective members near the end of their decision-making process. Establish lead prioritization, outreach standards, and handoffs while equipping the team with effective messaging, customer proof points, and objection-handling guidance.
Sales Playbooks and Pricing: Oversee Synapsa and 1Mind playbooks and responses to maintain consistent messaging and quality. Track conversion into paid bookings and establish pricing and discounting guidelines with leadership and Finance.
Brand and Communications: Maintain consistent brand positioning across the website, social media, events, and content. Oversee public relations, thought leadership, and storytelling that demonstrates member outcomes, collaborating with learning and community teams to highlight customer success.
Executive Thought Leadership: Define the role of community content and executive thought leadership, including the executive's personal brand, within the broader marketing strategy.
First 90-Day Priorities: Assess performance across acquisition, renewals, course-led membership purchases, and B2B revenue. Align bookings targets, budget, and decision-making responsibilities with leadership and Finance, address immediate conversion and renewal gaps, and initiate measurable AI and process improvements.
First-Year Results: Deliver against agreed bookings targets, improve acquisition efficiency and paid conversion, strengthen lifecycle-driven renewals, clarify positioning across offerings, develop a confident and accountable marketing team, and demonstrate measurable returns from AI and workflow improvements.

Requirements

You are an experienced marketing executive with a strong commercial mindset, a proven record of driving revenue, and the ability to combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution. You can develop managers, influence executive-level decisions, use data to guide investment, and build scalable acquisition and retention programs.

Senior Marketing Leadership: Significant experience leading marketing strategy, budgets, teams, and commercial results, ideally within membership, community, subscription, or recurring-revenue businesses.
Executive-Level Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to set priorities with senior leadership, challenge assumptions constructively, resolve competing demands, and secure the decisions and resources required to deliver results.
People Leadership: Proven ability to develop managers, build team confidence, clarify ownership, improve working practices, and strengthen performance through effective feedback and leadership.
Performance Marketing Expertise: Direct experience building and managing acquisition programs across paid media, SEO, or other performance channels. Ability to evaluate campaign performance, manage agencies or contractors, and make data-driven investment decisions.
Growth and Financial Acumen: Strong understanding of acquisition economics, customer acquisition costs, retention, payback periods, pricing, discounting, and budget management.
Bookings and Revenue Analytics: Ability to interpret commercial performance accurately, distinguish collected cash from pipeline or unpaid commitments, and establish reliable reporting that supports business decisions.
Product Marketing: Proven experience defining audience segments, developing product positioning and value propositions, planning launches, and communicating the relationships between multiple products or offerings.
Lifecycle Marketing: Demonstrated success building programs for activation, engagement, upgrades, renewal, referrals, and win-back, with measurable improvements in retention and revenue.
Sales Enablement and Conversion: Experience improving lead prioritization, nurture, direct outreach, sales handoffs, objection handling, and conversion into paid customers.
Content and Communications: Strong editorial judgment and the ability to guide brand messaging, thought leadership, public relations, digital experiences, and customer success storytelling.
AI and Automation: Practical experience building or deploying AI agents and marketing workflows. Ability to explain the tools used, demonstrate measurable improvements in cost, output, efficiency, or performance, and ensure appropriate human oversight of customer-facing work.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively with Finance, RevOps, Sales, Member Success, program teams, and executive leadership to align marketing execution with company-wide goals.
Player-Coach Mindset: Willingness and ability to move between strategic leadership and hands-on execution, especially when working with a lean team or addressing urgent business needs.
Preferred Experience: Familiarity with event marketing, community-driven growth, and storytelling for a global business serving go-to-market professionals.

Benefits

Annual Compensation: Competitive salary ranging from $250,000 to $275,000.
Performance Bonus: Bonus tied primarily to agreed bookings targets and commercial performance.
Equity Compensation: Stock options in a profitable, mission-driven company.
Healthcare: Comprehensive health benefits.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
Help people discover Sanctuary and keep coming back

A great night of music. A child’s first creative workshop. A gallery opening that brings neighbors together. A room full of people who arrived as strangers and left feeling connected.
At Sanctuary Cultural Arts Center, these experiences are at the heart of what we do. We’re looking for a Director of Marketing who can tell that story, reach new audiences, and turn interest into attendance, membership, and lasting support.
Sanctuary is a growing nonprofit cultural destination in downtown Maynard, offering live music, arts programming, family events, and community celebrations. With the opening of The Vestry, our new community and exhibition space, we’re expanding the ways people can experience and participate in Sanctuary.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines creative instincts with strong organization and a clear understanding of what makes people take action.

The Opportunity

You will lead Sanctuary’s marketing strategy, brand development, and day-to-day execution, with support from a staff member focused on on-the-ground marketing. This role combines creative ownership with the opportunity to supervise and mentor a colleague, building a coordinated approach to promoting Sanctuary’s programs, spaces, and mission.
Working closely with the Executive Director, talent buyers, event staff, artists, and community partners, you will grow audiences and strengthen Sanctuary’s role as a regional gathering place. Your work will support ticketed Main Hall performances, free Barside programming, The Vestry, private events, memberships, and fundraising initiatives.

Marketing strategy and campaign planning

Build an integrated marketing calendar that connects event promotion, community programming, memberships, fundraising, private event sales, and broader brand messaging.
Develop campaigns with clear audiences, messages, budgets, deadlines, and measurable goals.
Balance immediate ticket sales with the longer-term work of telling Sanctuary’s story, building awareness, and strengthening loyalty and community participation.

Event promotion and artist collaboration

Manage promotional timelines from event announcement through post-event follow-up.
Coordinate with artists and their representatives on promotional assets, shared posts, email outreach, and audience development.
Establish clear marketing expectations and follow through so every event receives consistent, timely promotion.
Collaborate with the Barside Talent Manager to help free performances attract audiences and introduce emerging artists to Sanctuary’s community.

Content brand and storytelling

Develop and refine a compelling brand messaging strategy and associated visual and written identity that reflect Sanctuary’s mission, personality, and role in the community.
Oversee engaging content for social media, email, the website, event listings, print materials, and paid advertising.
Create or coordinate compelling graphics, photography, short-form video, artist features, and stories about Sanctuary’s impact.
Maintain consistent branding while giving individual events a distinct personality.
Capture the energy of Sanctuary and give people a reason to attend, return, and bring a friend.

Team leadership and coordination

Supervise and mentor a staff member who supports on-the-ground marketing execution, providing clear priorities, guidance, and constructive feedback.
Delegate and coordinate activities such as poster and flyer distribution, community outreach, promotional material placement, and event coverage.
Establish a shared workflow with clear assignments, deadlines, and regular check-ins to keep campaigns moving.
Coordinate staff support, street team members, and volunteers so their efforts align with Sanctuary’s marketing calendar.
Build a collaborative working relationship that encourages initiative, develops skills, and connects everyday execution to measurable results.

Audience growth and community relationships

Grow Sanctuary’s email list, social audiences, attendance, and repeat visitation.
Develop relationships with local businesses, media outlets, arts organizations, tourism partners, and community groups.
Coordinate publicity, calendar listings, cross-promotions, and street team activity.
Work with leadership to communicate the value of memberships, donations, sponsorships, and community partnerships.

Digital marketing and performance

Manage email campaigns, audience segmentation, and paid digital advertising.
Keep event information accurate and make the path from discovery to purchase or RSVP easy to follow.
Use OpenDate, Meta, Google Analytics, and related tools to understand what drives results.
Deliver a concise weekly report showing performance, lessons learned, and recommended next steps.
Manage the marketing budget and improve how Sanctuary allocates its time and advertising dollars.

What success looks like

Success means more people discovering Sanctuary, more well-attended events, and stronger relationships with the people who support our mission. Together with the Executive Director, you will establish practical goals for:
Ticket sales, attendance, and event revenue.
RSVPs and attendance at free community programs.
Email subscriber growth, engagement, and ticket purchases.
Advertising effectiveness and return on spending.
Membership growth, renewals, and fundraising participation.
Qualified wedding and private event inquiries.
Repeat attendance, media coverage, and community partnerships.

You’ll be expected to explain what the numbers mean and recommend what we should do next.

What you bring

Demonstrated success in marketing for live entertainment, arts and culture, hospitality, nonprofits, or another audience-driven organization.
Strong writing skills and an eye for compelling visual content.
Experience with email marketing, social media, paid advertising, and campaign analysis.
The ability to manage multiple deadlines while keeping details accurate.
Confidence working with artists, colleagues, volunteers, vendors, and community partners.
Sound judgment about budgets, priorities, and where effort will make the greatest difference.
A collaborative approach and a willingness to create, publish, troubleshoot, and follow through.
Enthusiasm for live music, the arts, and the role a welcoming cultural space can play in community life.

Experience with OpenDate, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, Canva or Adobe Creative Suite, and website content management is helpful. Regional media relationships and familiarity with the Greater Boston and MetroWest arts communities are a plus.
We value demonstrated results, creative thinking, and reliable execution. Candidates with relevant experience from a variety of backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Why Sanctuary?

This is an opportunity to help shape a growing cultural organization and see the results of your work in the room: a fuller audience, a new connection, a returning family, or an artist reaching new fans. You’ll have meaningful creative ownership, close collaboration with leadership, and the chance to help make Sanctuary a destination people feel part of.

How to apply

Send your résumé, a brief introduction, and two or three examples of marketing work to
kevin.baker@sanctuarymaynard.com with the subject line “Director of Marketing — Sanctuary.”
For at least one example, tell us the goal, your role, and the results. We’d also love to hear what excites you about building Sanctuary’s audience and community.

Sanctuary Cultural Arts Center, Inc.

A 501(c)(3) nonprofit fostering community through arts, culture, and live experiences
82 Main Street - Maynard, MA 01754
www.sanctuarymaynard.com

new_jobs.title: Director Wellness Marketing
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Discover greater levels of performance. With over 1,400 stores throughout the U.S. and an innovative omni-channel ecosystem, Ulta Beauty is revolutionizing the beauty retail experience. Ulta Beauty is expanding its digital capabilities, opening new stores on a continual basis and re-designing existing locations with the latest design and technological advancements for heightened guest experiences. We’re not just growing, we’re thriving through consistent innovation and a bold commitment to re-imagination. If you want the opportunity to build something strategic, to take ownership of your career trajectory, to apply your passion to operational excellence, Ulta Beauty provides the kind of stability and support few organizations can match. So be curious. Be flexible. Be more than you thought possible. The future is yours at Ulta Beauty.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Use your passion, experience and talents to build something BEAUTIFUL!

The Director, Wellness Marketing will be a key leader responsible for defining and bringing to life the end-to-end marketing strategy for Wellness at Ulta Beauty. This leader will establish how Wellness shows up for our guests across the full marketing ecosystem—building awareness, credibility and engagement while translating business priorities, guest insights and cultural trends into integrated marketing strategies that drive category growth.

Reporting to the Vice President, Wellness Commercial Lead, this role will serve as the primary marketing leader for the Wellness business and a critical bridge between the Wellness and Marketing organizations. The Director will work closely with Marketing leadership and functional teams across brand and integrated marketing, media, social, customer growth marketing, creative, consumer insights and other channels to ensure Wellness is thoughtfully and cohesively integrated throughout Ulta Beauty's marketing plans.

Importantly, this leader will help shape how Beauty and Wellness come together at Ulta Beauty, identifying opportunities to connect the categories through relevant guest experiences, storytelling, campaigns and activations. The Director will own the Wellness positioning and brand strategy, helping establish how Ulta Beauty earns credibility and builds a differentiated position in Wellness while remaining authentic to the broader Ulta Beauty brand.

The Director will lead a Wellness Marketing Manager, and will operate through significant cross-functional influence across both the Wellness organization and the broader enterprise. The ideal candidate is a strong brand strategist and storyteller who combines the art and science of marketing, thrives in an entrepreneurial environment and can translate an ambitious business strategy into compelling guest-facing experiences. This builds upon the existing Wellness Marketing role's mandate around omnichannel campaigns, Wellness brand identity and partnership across Wellness and Marketing, while elevating accountability to Director-level strategy, leadership and enterprise integration.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Own the end-to-end marketing strategy for Wellness by Ulta Beauty, translating the Wellness business strategy, growth priorities, guest insights and cultural trends into a differentiated, full-funnel marketing strategy across paid, owned and earned channels.
Define the annual and long-range Wellness marketing strategy, including audience priorities, positioning, messaging, campaign architecture, channel strategy and measurement approach, ensuring marketing plans support both category growth and Ulta Beauty brand objectives.
Own and evolve the Wellness brand strategy and positioning in alignment with the Ulta Beauty Brand, establishing how Ulta Beauty builds authority, relevance and credibility in Wellness and translating that strategy into clear and compelling guest-facing storytelling and experiences.
Serve as the primary connector between the Wellness and Marketing organizations, working closely with Marketing leadership and functional teams to integrate Wellness priorities across brand and integrated marketing, media, social, customer growth marketing, creative, consumer insights and other marketing capabilities.
Champion the integration of Beauty + Wellness across Ulta Beauty's marketing ecosystem, identifying opportunities to connect categories and guest needs through enterprise campaigns, seasonal moments, cultural moments, content and activations.
Lead the development of integrated, omnichannel Wellness campaigns and initiatives from strategy through execution, including strategic briefs, messaging, go-to-market plans, channel integration and measurement.
Partner with Marketing leaders and channel owners to determine the optimal marketing mix for Wellness, including paid and organic media, social, CRM/customer growth, digital, content, in-store and other guest touchpoints.
Serve as an indispensable partner to Wellness Merchandising and brand partners, developing marketing strategies and activations that support category priorities, accelerate established brands, successfully introduce emerging brands and create differentiated reasons for guests to shop Wellness at Ulta Beauty. This partnership model builds on the existing Wellness Marketing Manager mandate.
Partner with the Vice President, Wellness on development and stewardship of the overall Wellness marketing budget; own execution of marketing spend in partnership with Marketing functional leaders, ensuring investments are aligned to strategic priorities and deployed effectively.
Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks for Wellness marketing; analyze campaign and business performance, synthesize learnings and continuously optimize marketing strategies, investments and execution.
Maintain a strong pulse on Wellness, retail and consumer trends, cultural shifts, competitive dynamics and emerging marketing capabilities, translating insights into opportunities for Ulta Beauty. The source roles similarly emphasize industry trends, consumer behavior and competitive knowledge as inputs to strategy.
Lead, coach and develop the Wellness Marketing Manager, fostering strategic thinking, strong execution, collaboration and accountability while creating opportunities for professional growth.
Build strong relationships and influence across a highly matrixed organization, aligning diverse stakeholders around a clear Wellness marketing vision and translating ambiguity into actionable strategies and plans.
Develop and present compelling marketing strategies, recommendations and business updates to senior leadership, effectively communicating the role of marketing in driving Wellness growth.

REQUIREMENTS FOR CONSIDERATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or related field; MBA or MA preferred.
10+ years of progressive consumer marketing experience, with demonstrated success developing brand, category and/or integrated marketing strategies that drive measurable business results.
5+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to develop talent and build high-performing teams.
Proven expertise developing and leading 360° integrated marketing strategies and campaigns across the consumer funnel and multiple marketing channels, consistent with the expectations established for Ulta Beauty's Director-level category marketing leadership.
Strong brand strategist and storyteller with experience translating consumer insights, business objectives and cultural trends into differentiated positioning, messaging and marketing experiences.
Deep understanding of the modern marketing ecosystem, including brand and integrated marketing, paid media, social and content, CRM/customer growth marketing, digital and retail experiences.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a complex, matrixed organization and build trusted relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
Strategic thinker with a strong data-driven mindset and ability to move fluidly between long-range strategy and detailed execution.
Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building new capabilities, strategies and ways of working in a fast-paced, evolving business.
Strong financial acumen with experience managing marketing investments, agency resources and complex budgets.
Exceptional written, verbal and presentation skills, including experience developing and presenting high-impact recommendations to senior leadership.
High emotional intelligence with the ability to adapt communication and leadership style to diverse internal and external stakeholders.
Experience managing creative, media and/or other external agency partners.
Wellness industry/category experience preferred, with a strong understanding of the Wellness consumer, cultural landscape and evolving category dynamics considered a plus.
Passion for the business, curiosity and a commitment to being a lifelong learner.

The pay range for this position is $147,300.00 - $200,000.00 / Year with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn additional compensation pursuant to the Company’s bonus plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta

About

At Ulta Beauty
(NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful
. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest records, conviction records, or other criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of any applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Performance Marketing
new_jobs.description:
About Mueller Communications

Mueller Communications is a full-service communications, public relations and marketing firm based in Milwaukee. For more than 40 years, we've helped organizations, leaders and influencers tell their stories and amplify their impact through comprehensive marketing campaigns, media relations, public affairs, creative, and crisis communications. Today, our team of nearly 50 professionals serves clients across a diverse set of industries, and we're proud that many of our senior staff have called Mueller home for a decade or more.

With integrity at the heart of everything we do, our team of strategic communicators and problem solvers is committed to doing right by our clients, our community and each other.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Senior Manager-Performance Marketing is a collaborative problem solver who strategizes, builds, and optimizes campaigns to achieve measurable client goals. They set search-led demand generation strategy, direct junior campaign staff on execution, stay hands-on with our most complex accounts, and deliver and clearly communicate the results clients care about: qualified leads and pipeline.

The performance marketing function at Mueller Communications serves a diverse set of organizations including local, national, B2B, B2C, non-profit, for-profit, professional services, and eCommerce. Much of our work is lead generation for B2B and niche-industry clients, where a qualified lead is worth real money and attribution is the difference between a campaign that looks good and one that proves ROI.

Today, roughly two-thirds of Google searches end without a click. Winning there takes a ‘search everywhere’ approach: paid (SEM), organic (SEO), and AI visibility (AIO / GEO / AEO) managed as one program, fed by authoritative content, made credible by third-party coverage and endorsement. Mueller's elite talent works across every discipline that shapes search; we are seeking a performance marketer who can lead clients through this shift, seeing around the next corner before their competitors do.

What You'll Be Doing

Paid Media Campaign Management

Set strategy for and lead the builds of best-in-class paid search campaigns (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), plus paid social and programmatic where client goals warrant
Stay hands-on with our most complex accounts: campaign architecture, budget pacing, bidding strategy, audience and keyword development, and structured testing
Drive lead generation as the primary outcome, and eCommerce revenue where clients sell direct, optimizing to cost per qualified lead, pipeline contribution, and ROAS rather than platform metrics alone.

Demand Generation & Lead Gen Attribution

Build demand as well as capture it, shaping audience strategy, nurture sequencing, and the content programs that reach buyers before they start searching
Architect full-funnel attribution: connect ad platforms to CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce and similar) and, where needed, systems like ERPs, so lead scoring and qualification tie spend to opportunities and revenue
Provide actionable insights, direct optimization response, and set strategy using analytics platforms such as Google Analytics/Tag Manager/Search Console, SEMRush, CallRail, Google Data Studio, and Mueller’s internal suite of tracking and analysis tools.
Lead client-facing performance summary presentations that articulate key takeaways and showcase campaign impact in alignment with client goals

Search & AI Visibility

Work with our SEO team to guide organic strategy and direct its execution, ensuring paid and organic search work as one program rather than two silos
Continue to evolve the firm's approach to AI search visibility: how clients appear in AI Overviews and in answers generated by LLMs, and how we measure and grow that presence
Work with Mueller's proprietary, industry-leading AI search visibility and optimization platform, and help drive its continued evolution

Team & Project Management

Direct and develop junior campaign staff, delegating execution while owning strategy and quality
Own the firm's performance reporting, providing humanized communication of ROI in alignment with client goals
Optimize the firm's campaign planning and delivery process
Lead campaign activities in collaboration with the Client Lead (goal setting and reporting, projections, monthly planning, and regular internal client reviews)

Client Management

Be a strategic and analytical voice of the firm on our most complex campaigns
Collaborate with the Client Lead, or in some cases act as Client Lead, to ensure the Mueller team is a trusted partner, proactively providing clients with timely, useful, trusted information

Strategy Development | Entrepreneurial Mindset

Set and manage big-picture goals for clients and the firm and demonstrate passion for and ownership of achieving them
Contribute proactive ideas and suggestions for how to grow business from current clients
Pursue new business opportunities for the firm, including participation in pitch meetings and proposal development
Keep the firm at the forefront of the search industry by identifying technology, trends, and insights to be leveraged in both work delivery and business development

Qualifications That Will Make You Stand Out

7+ years in digital marketing with deep, hands-on paid search (SEM) expertise: you have owned strategy, budgets, and performance on complex accounts
Lead gen attribution you have built yourself: CRM-connected measurement (HubSpot, Salesforce or similar), lead scoring, full-funnel reporting, and comfort speaking in pipeline and revenue terms. Demand generation experience beyond capture is a plus.
A search everywhere mindset: working knowledge of SEO, a genuine point of view on AI search visibility (AIO/GEO), and an instinct for managing paid, organic, and AI presence as one program. Organic and AI search expertise will make you stand out, but we are willing to develop it in someone whose paid search and attribution credentials are proven.
Experience directing and developing junior staff, with a demonstrated desire to teach, mentor, and promote a positive team mentality
B2B or niche-industry experience preferred
Prior agency experience preferred, but not required
Proven ability to translate complex analyses into actionable recommendations that drive tangible results
Intrinsic sense of ownership of your domain and pride in your impact on the success of clients and the firm
Experience in client-facing roles with a strong track record of building long-tenured relationships that deliver on shared goals
This is a flexible hybrid role based in Milwaukee, WI

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

Total Rewards offering that includes a competitive salary, 401(k) and profit-sharing, bonuses, and comprehensive health and wellness benefits
Award-winning culture that earned us Milwaukee Business Journal's Best Place to Work 7 years running (2020 - 2026)
Beautiful newly-renovated modern workspace perfected for collaboration
Flexible hybrid working model that prioritizes work/life balance so you can live your best life at work and at home
Emphasis on professional development that includes paid membership in professional associations, internal lunches to support company growth and other career ambitions
One-of-a-kind concierge program dedicated to help the entire Mueller team discover an improved sense of workplace satisfaction, celebration, and organization
Regular Happy Hours and company outings to socialize with colleagues, have fun, and strengthen the team
Fully stocked kitchen so no one ever has to skip breakfast or lunch to meet their deadlines

Showcases Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons. Connects into resources in their region. Liaises and builds deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization. Develops and executes basic marketing strategy across multiple outlets and for the positioning and pull-through of continent strategy that align with hotel goals. Supports and implements marketing strategies designed to drive topline revenue and achieve RevPar/share-of-wallet goals. Manages all internal and external communication, digital presence, including but not limited to property website, third party channels and social media while maintaining brand integrity. Activates incremental marketing opportunities ranging from partnerships, third-party sites and CVBs. Reports out on campaign performance to SMR (Sales, Marketing & Revenue Management) leadership as requested.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience Required:

2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in

the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred

OR

4-year bachelor's degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Marketing and Digital

Develops and executes the overarching marketing strategy from marketing plans to budgets for hotel/group of hotels that align with business priorities, with support and consultation of the General Manager(s).
Cultivates partnership with and active participation in demand generation strategy development (SMR).
Reconciles marketing plan monthly with accruals, forecast in conjunction with Director of Finance.
Leads and/or partners with Hotel Operations to conceptualize/execute property-level Programming and Activation, based on brand guidelines.

As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.

We Are The People Who Give Possibilities Purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.

Job Description

About the role:

We are seeking a collaborative, results-oriented Growth Marketing
Campaign Manager
to join our US Regional Marketing team. This role will plan, execute, and optimize integrated marketing campaigns that build awareness, generate demand, and support commercial growth.

The Campaign Manager will coordinate campaigns across internal teams, agencies, and external partners, with responsibility for third-party media planning and trafficking and the day-to-day management of the US Google Ads account.

Key Responsibilities

Omnichannel Growth Marketing & Demand Generation

Develop integrated demand generation campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, qualified leads, pipeline growth, and revenue
Execute omnichannel growth marketing campaigns across web, email, SEO/SEM, paid media, social media, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing programs
Translate marketing priorities into actionable campaign plans with defined audiences, tactics, timelines, budgets, and KPIs.
Manage third-party media programs, including media coordination, asset delivery, tracking requirements, budgets, and performance.
Coordinate the accurate implementation of campaign tracking, UTM parameters, landing pages, and other digital campaign elements.
Manage multiple campaigns and deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail.
Develop and adapt campaign content for select marketing channels, including email, digital advertising, landing pages, and third-party media, in collaboration with product marketing, agencies, and other internal partners.

Paid Media Management

Coordinate with agency partners to monitor pacing, performance, and optimization opportunities of Search Engine Marketing campaigns
Review search terms, ad copy, keywords, audiences and performance to recommend improvements.
Coordinate with product managers to implement new campaigns
Support paid media reporting and communicate actionable insights to stakeholders.

Performance & Insights

Track and report performance against key business metrics
Monitor campaign performance and recommend adjustments to improve engagement, conversions, lead generation, and marketing efficiency.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field.

Hands-on experience executing multichannel marketing campaigns.
Experience with paid media, media agencies, publishers, or advertising vendors.
Working knowledge of Google Ads or another paid-search platform; hands-on Google Ads experience preferred.
Understanding of digital marketing metrics such as CTR, conversions, cost per conversion, and ROAS.
Strong project management, organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
Familiarity with Salesforce, Marketo, Google Analytics, or comparable CRM, marketing automation, and analytics platforms is preferred.
B2B, life sciences, biotechnology, healthcare, or other technical industry experience is preferred.

About Matrix Adhesives

Founded in 2021, Matrix Adhesives Group is a growth-driven company committed to delivering high-performance bonding and sealing solutions across diverse industries. We bring together some of the most trusted and innovative brands in the adhesives and sealants market - each with a proven legacy of quality, performance, and reliability.

Our portfolio includes industry-leading names–each contributing unique expertise and capabilities to meet the evolving needs of our customers. Through our brands, we offer a comprehensive range of products engineered for construction, industrial, commercial, and specialty applications.

At the core of our business is a relentless focus on operational excellence, customer partnership, and cutting-edge research and development. We don’t just supply adhesives. We help build stronger, safer, and more efficient systems for the future.

Matrix Adhesives Group is more than a supplier. We are your collaborative partner backed by a powerhouse of leading brands - committed to performance, innovation, and long-term value.

For more information visit https://www.matrixadhesives.com/.

About The Role

The Technical Marketing Leader will own all marketing activities for products and brands sold into technical and industrial applications within the Matrix portfolio. This includes the Self-Seal® Firestopping product line, SCIGRIP® and related products used in product fabrication, and transportation applications. These product lines have many growth opportunities in the market including adjacent applications, new technologies/products, share gain, new customer acquisition, and channel development.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Develop and execute market strategies and growth plans for technical and industrial product lines, translating business objectives into prioritized initiatives, measurable targets, and clear go-to-market actions.
Lead market, customer, and competitive analysis to identify unmet needs, emerging trends, adjacent applications, and opportunities for share gain, customer acquisition, and channel expansion.
Partner with Product Director, Sales, Technical Service, and Operations to plan and execute product launches, including positioning, value propositions, sales enablement, launch communications, and post-launch performance tracking.
Manage brand strategy and messaging across the technical portfolio, ensuring consistent positioning, differentiated value propositions, and effective application across customer touchpoints and marketing materials.
Build industry engagement and thought leadership through customer insights, technical content, trade associations, events, and other channels that strengthen market credibility and brand visibility.
Support key account growth by developing account-specific value propositions, customer presentations, commercial tools, and marketing programs in partnership with Sales and technical teams.
Lead demand generation programs across relevant channels, define success metrics, monitor pipeline and campaign performance, and optimize investments based on results.
Travel 20%-40%

Strategic Thinking
Customer Focus
Commercial Acumen
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Communication
Project Management

7-10 years B2B marketing experience.
Experience with technical construction products (eg. HVAC, specified systems).
Bachelor's degree in marketing, engineering or a related field.

MBA preferred.
Experience in firestopping applications/channels.
Experience in transportation sourcing/production (marine, RV, rail, automotive).
Industrial fabrication or maintenance exposure.
